papers.title: Rainfall, Exposure and Reporting: What Controls the Spatial Pattern of Flash Floods in Saudi Arabia?

summary.en: Constructs a Saudi Arabian flood-event record from news extracted by an LLM and analyzes spatial flood patterns in relation to rainfall, population, land use, and news growth.
summary.zh: 利用由LLM从新闻中提取的信息构建沙特阿拉伯洪水事件记录，并分析洪水空间模式与降雨、人口、土地利用和新闻增长之间的关系。

details.en: The study analyzes 3867 reported flood episodes across 147 Saudi governorates from 2010–2025, validates a sample manually, and examines regional concentration, rainfall frequency, and reporting effects. It concludes that reported flood concentration is mainly related to rainfall and that rising reports reflect online-news growth rather than increased flooding.
details.zh: 该研究分析了2010–2025年间沙特147个省中报告的3867起洪水事件，手动验证了一个样本，并考察了区域集中度、降雨频率和报道效应。研究得出结论：报告的洪水集中度主要与降雨有关，而报告数量的增加反映的是网络新闻增长，而不是洪水增加。

papers.title: Retrieval-augmented LLM decision support for river water quality monitoring: a Manchester case study

summary.en: A multi-agent RAG-LLM framework supports natural-language analysis and evidence-grounded decision-making for river water quality monitoring.
summary.zh: 一种多智能体 RAG-LLM 框架支持对河流水质监测进行自然语言分析和基于证据的决策。

details.en: The paper evaluates specialised agents for query understanding, retrieval, data analysis, visualisation, and grounded response generation using Greater Manchester river monitoring data. It assesses water-quality trends, pollution hotspots, monitoring coverage, and station status, reporting accuracy, completeness, groundedness, and hallucination results.
details.zh: 该论文使用 Greater Manchester 河流监测数据，评估用于查询理解、检索、数据分析、可视化和基于依据的响应生成的专门化智能体。该研究评估水质趋势、污染热点、监测覆盖范围和监测站状态，并报告准确性、完整性、基于依据的程度和幻觉结果。

papers.title: Ontology and LLM-based Extraction of Wastewater Unit Process Data from Permit Documents for Improved Sector-Level Cost and Emissions Analysis

summary.en: The paper develops and validates an ontology-assisted LLM method to extract wastewater treatment unit-process data from NPDES permits, then uses the resulting dataset to estimate infrastructure investment needs and greenhouse gas emissions for California facilities.
summary.zh: 该论文开发并验证了一种本体辅助的 LLM 方法，用于从 NPDES 许可证中提取废水处理单元工艺数据，随后利用所得数据估算加利福尼亚州设施的基础设施投资需求和温室气体排放。

details.en: It compares keyword extraction, predefined-list LLM extraction, and Water Treatment ontology-based LLM extraction. The ontology-based approach using GPT-5 mini achieves a unit-process F1 score of 0.89 and is applied to 609 California facilities with active permits.
details.zh: 该方法比较了关键词提取、预定义列表 LLM 提取和基于 Water Treatment 本体的 LLM 提取。使用 GPT-5 mini 的基于本体的方法达到了 0.89 的单元工艺 F1 分数，并应用于 609 个拥有有效许可证的加利福尼亚州设施。

papers.title: Comparison of Multimodal Large Language Models for Phytoplankton Identification from Microscopy Images

summary.en: Compares multimodal large language models for phytoplankton identification from microscopy images, evaluating their suitability for ecological monitoring and water quality assessment.
summary.zh: 比较用于从显微镜图像中识别浮游植物的多模态大型语言模型，评估其对生态监测和水质评估的适用性。

details.en: The paper compares six off-the-shelf multimodal models on expert-verified phytoplankton images and evaluates GPT-5.6 Sol on an expanded dataset. It reports taxonomic-resolution-dependent performance and concludes that current systems may support preliminary screening but require expert verification.
details.zh: 该论文在经专家验证的浮游植物图像上比较了六种现成的多模态模型，并在扩展数据集上评估了 GPT-5.6 Sol。论文报告了依赖分类学分辨率的性能，并得出结论：当前系统可支持初步筛查，但需要专家验证。

limitations.en: The study was limited by small, purposively selected and taxonomically unbalanced image sets, restricted mixed-community coverage, results tied to specific prompting conditions, and limited reproducibility and generalizability owing to run-to-run variability and dynamically updated commercial models.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限包括图像集规模较小、为目的性选取且分类学分布不均，混合群落覆盖有限，结果受特定提示条件限制，以及商业模型运行间变异和持续更新所导致的可重复性与普适性有限。

papers.title: Uncovering Gaps in Critical Infrastructure Flood Exposure Assessment: A Hybrid Rule–LLM Framework
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A hybrid rule–LLM framework for identifying gaps in critical infrastructure flood exposure assessment.
summary.zh: 一种用于识别关键基础设施洪水暴露评估中缺口的规则–LLM混合框架。

details.en: The work addresses flood exposure assessment for critical infrastructure using a hybrid rule-based and LLM framework. The abstract only describes the item as supplemental tables for a manuscript.
details.zh: 该工作使用基于规则和LLM的混合框架，对关键基础设施进行洪水暴露评估。摘要仅将该项目描述为论文的补充表格。

papers.title: TP-Agent: An Auditable LLM Agent for Predicting Pollutant Transformation Products in Oxidative Water Treatment

summary.en: TP-Agent is an auditable LLM-driven system for ranking transformation-product candidates of organic micropollutants during oxidative water treatment.
summary.zh: TP-Agent 是一个可审计的 LLM 驱动系统，用于对氧化水处理过程中有机微污染物的转化产物候选物进行排序。

details.en: The paper evaluates TP-Agent on standardized-parent-disjoint reactions, comparing it with a bare LLM, RAG, and TP-Transformer, while assessing structural traceability, candidate-linked rationales, latency, and cost.
details.zh: 该论文在标准化母体不相交反应上评估 TP-Agent，并将其与裸 LLM、RAG 和 TP-Transformer 进行比较，同时评估结构可追溯性、与候选物关联的推理依据、延迟和成本。

papers.venue: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction

papers.title: Desalination LLM: Large Language Model Agents Design Efficient Graphene Membranes for Water Desalination

summary.en: LLM agents design graphene nanopores for water desalination, using predictor feedback to optimize water flux and ion rejection.
summary.zh: LLM agents 设计用于水脱盐的石墨烯纳米孔，使用预测器反馈来优化水通量和离子截留率。

details.en: The preprint presents a tool-using LLM design framework that grows graphene nanopores atom by atom and uses pretrained predictors to evaluate water flux and ion rejection. It compares two LLM agents with conversation-only versions and non-LLM scaffold baselines.
details.zh: 该预印本介绍了一种使用工具的 LLM 设计框架，该框架逐原子构建石墨烯纳米孔，并使用预训练预测器评估水通量和离子截留率。该框架将两个 LLM agent 与仅进行对话的版本和非 LLM 支架基线进行了比较。

papers.title: From inundation rasters to draft action briefs: integrating spatial computing and LLM agents for urban waterlogging emergency decision support

summary.en: A decision-support framework combines event-specific inundation and spatial analysis with retrieval-augmented LLM agents to draft evacuation and resource-allocation action briefs for urban waterlogging emergencies.
summary.zh: 一个决策支持框架将特定事件的淹没分析和空间分析与检索增强型 LLM 智能体相结合，为城市内涝紧急情况起草疏散和资源分配行动简报。

details.en: The study applies the MAEDF-UW framework to the 20 July 2021 Zhengzhou rainstorm. It derives inundation, water-depth, road-accessibility, and rescue-island information, then combines structured spatial facts with local contingency-plan rules. LLM-based agents generate schema- and rule-checked JSON briefs for human review, with evaluation dimensions covering consistency, spatial-input accuracy, and latency.
details.zh: 该研究将 MAEDF-UW 框架应用于 2021 年 7 月 20 日郑州暴雨事件。研究获取淹没、水深、道路可通行性和救援岛信息，然后将结构化空间事实与当地应急预案规则相结合。基于 LLM 的智能体生成经过模式和规则检查的 JSON 简报，供人工审查，评估维度涵盖一致性、空间输入准确性和延迟。

papers.title: Data and code for "Mapping drought and water-use research in potato: a bibliometric analysis of 1,358 Scopus-indexed articles (2000–2024)"
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A research artifact containing data and code for a bibliometric mapping study of drought and water-use research in potato, including LLM-assisted relevance and thematic classification validated against human judgements.
summary.zh: 一个包含数据和代码的研究成果，用于对马铃薯干旱与用水研究开展文献计量学映射研究，其中包括经人工判断验证的 LLM 辅助相关性和主题分类。

details.en: The record provides the Scopus search protocol, Python analysis pipeline, included and excluded records, summary tables, validation samples, classification judgements, evaluation metrics, SDG queries, and figures. LLM-assisted first-pass judgements were used for relevance and thematic classification.
details.zh: 该记录提供了 Scopus 检索方案、Python 分析流程、纳入和排除的记录、汇总表、验证样本、分类判断、评估指标、SDG 查询和图表。LLM 辅助的初步判断用于相关性和主题分类。

papers.title: Data Fragmentation as a Critical Bottleneck in Disaster Response Planning: The EVAC-AI Case Study for Flood Risk Assessment
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Symposium Series

summary.en: EVAC-AI integrates fragmented coastal flood and evacuation data in a knowledge graph and provides natural-language, map-linked decision support for flood evacuation planning.
summary.zh: EVAC-AI 将碎片化的沿海洪水和疏散数据整合到知识图谱中，并为洪水疏散规划提供自然语言、地图链接的决策支持。

details.en: The paper presents a Neo4j knowledge graph combining FEMA flood zones, NOAA tide readings, evacuation routes, and crowdsourced reports, with a natural-language query pipeline for coastal flood evacuation planning in Virginia Beach.
details.zh: 该论文介绍了一个 Neo4j 知识图谱，将 FEMA 洪水区、NOAA 潮汐读数、疏散路线和众包报告相结合，并配备用于弗吉尼亚海滩沿海洪水疏散规划的自然语言查询流程。

papers.title: Global news reports reveal the human dimensions of water scarcity

summary.en: The study uses large language models to identify reported water-scarcity events across 190 countries and compares their global patterns with hydrologic assessments.
summary.zh: 该研究使用大语言模型识别190个国家报告的缺水事件，并将其全球模式与水文评估结果进行比较。

details.en: It analyzes news reports from 2014–2024 to reveal human, infrastructural, institutional, and geographic dimensions of reported water scarcity, finding patterns that only partially align with hydrology-based maps.
details.zh: 该研究分析2014–2024年的新闻报道，以揭示报告的水资源短缺的人文、基础设施、制度和地理维度，发现这些模式仅与基于水文的地图部分一致。

limitations.en: The study is limited by nonrepresentative and biased news coverage, geographic-resolution mismatches, possible LLM classification errors across linguistic and geographic contexts, lack of independent verification of reported events, and duplicate reporting of the same occurrence.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于新闻报道并不具有代表性且存在偏倚、地理分辨率不匹配、LLM 在不同语言和地理环境下可能出现分类错误、报道事件缺乏独立核验，以及同一事件可能被重复报道。

papers.title: A Skill-Guided LLM Agent for Process-Aware Calibration of Large-Scale Hydrological Models: Demonstration with VIC v5.1.0

summary.en: A Skill-guided LLM agent is developed for process-aware calibration of the VIC hydrological model and evaluated in the Jialing River Basin.
summary.zh: 开发了一种由技能引导的 LLM 智能体，用于 VIC 水文模型的过程感知校准，并在嘉陵江流域进行了评估。

details.en: The study organizes hydrological knowledge into Diagnosis, Adjustment, Evaluation, and Verification skills. The agent diagnoses streamflow errors, proposes physically constrained parameter changes, and verifies them through deterministic simulations, improving selected streamflow and flood-event metrics relative to baseline and comparison methods.
details.zh: 该研究将水文知识组织为诊断、调整、评估和验证技能。该智能体诊断流量误差，提出受物理约束的参数变化，并通过确定性模拟进行验证；与基线方法和对比方法相比，改善了选定的流量指标和洪水事件指标。

limitations.en: The study primarily optimizes NSE at the expense of some hydrological signatures, lacks long-term knowledge accumulation across basins and calibration cases, and evaluates only one distributed hydrological model in one basin, limiting demonstrated transferability.
limitations.zh: 该研究主要优化NSE而牺牲了部分水文特征，尚不具备跨流域和校准案例的长期知识积累能力，且仅评估了一个分布式水文模型和一个流域，因此其可迁移性受到限制。

papers.title: Not Faster, but Better: Experience and Guidelines from a Year of AI Use in Groundwater Modeling

summary.en: The article reports a year of AI-assisted consulting experience in groundwater modeling and presents a staged workflow for using language models to improve planning, critique, and implementation.
summary.zh: 该文章报告了在地下水建模中为期一年的 AI 辅助咨询经验，并提出了分阶段工作流程，利用语言模型改进规划、批评和实施。

details.en: It describes how AI use changed the balance between planning and implementation in groundwater modeling, explains role-based and staged use of models, discusses model limitations and costs, and relates the experience to water and its allocation.
details.zh: 文章描述了 AI 的使用如何改变地下水建模中规划与实施之间的平衡，解释了基于角色和分阶段使用模型的方法，讨论了模型的局限性和成本，并将这一经验与水及其分配联系起来。

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability-Guided Selective Fine-Tuning of Vision–Language Models for Centimeter-Level Flood Depth Estimation
papers.venue: 2026 25th International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA)

limitations.en: The study is limited to a single VLM architecture, uses a 300-image real-world test set that underrepresents nighttime/low-light scenes, depths above 30 cm, and scenes without vehicle reference objects, and relies on wheel-arch cues that become brittle when submerged.
limitations.zh: 该研究仅限于单一视觉语言模型架构，所用的300张真实世界测试集对夜间/低光照场景、超过30厘米的水深以及缺乏车辆参照物的场景覆盖不足，并且依赖的轮拱线索在被水淹没时会变得脆弱。

papers.title: From social media to flood 3D scenes: leveraging large language models and knowledge graphs for flood spatiotemporal evolution representation
papers.venue: International Journal of Geographical Information Science

summary.en: Uses ontology-constrained LLMs and knowledge graphs to extract flood spatiotemporal knowledge from social media, reconstruct flood evolution pathways, and represent them as 3D scenes.
summary.zh: 使用本体约束的LLMs和知识图谱从社交媒体中提取洪水时空知识，重建洪水演化路径，并将其表示为3D场景。

details.en: The study analyzes 34,731 tweets from the 2021 European floods and develops a prototype for 3D flood representation. It evaluates flood knowledge extraction and evolutionary pathway reconstruction, reporting improved interpretability for understanding flood processes and supporting disaster prevention and mitigation.
details.zh: 该研究分析了2021年欧洲洪灾的34,731条推文，并开发了一个用于3D洪水表示的原型。研究评估了洪水知识提取和演化路径重建，报告称这提高了理解洪水过程以及支持灾害预防和减灾的可解释性。

papers.title: Flumen: an agentic, GPU-accelerated program for flood and coastal hydrodynamics, its architecture and its calibration against laboratory and inter-model benchmarks
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: Flumen is a GPU-accelerated hydrodynamic program for flood and coastal-flow simulation that exposes model-building, execution, and calibration capabilities to a language-model agent.
summary.zh: Flumen 是一个 GPU 加速的水动力学程序，用于洪水和沿海流动模拟，并向语言模型代理提供模型构建、执行和校准功能。

details.en: The paper describes Rust CPU/GPU solvers for shallow-water, river-network, estuarine, and dispersive-wave problems, and evaluates them against verification, flood, and laboratory coastal-hydrodynamics benchmarks.
details.zh: 该论文介绍了用于浅水、河网、河口和色散波问题的 Rust CPU/GPU 求解器，并根据验证、洪水和实验室沿海水动力学基准对其进行了评估。

limitations.en: The study has not yet calibrated or validated Flumen against field floods with measured depths; its depth-integrated, threshold-based breaking cannot improve breaking-bore gauges, wall-impact treatment was calibrated on one experiment with grid-dependent peaks and cannot reproduce splash jets, the river and three-dimensional schemes have stated physical and validation limits, calibration uses only a single Manning scale, GPU precision causes salt-mass drift, and the proposed neural surrogate has not been built.
limitations.zh: 该研究尚未使用实测水深对 Flumen 进行现场洪水校准或验证；其深度积分且基于阈值的破碎处理无法改善破碎涌波的测站结果，墙面冲击处理仅在一个实验上校准、峰值随网格变化且无法再现飞溅射流，河流和三维方案存在明确的物理与验证局限，校准仅采用单一 Manning 缩放因子，GPU 精度会导致盐质量漂移，且拟议的神经代理模型尚未建立。

papers.title: Schema-Primed Knowledge-Augmented Approach to Water Injection Diagnostics and Closed-Loop Reservoir Dynamic Analysis
papers.venue: Abu Dhabi International Petroleum Exhibition & Conference (ADIPEC)

summary.en: A schema-primed knowledge-augmented language-model framework with persistent agentic memory supports water-injection diagnosis and closed-loop reservoir dynamic analysis.
summary.zh: 一种由模式预置的知识增强语言模型框架，结合持久化智能体记忆，支持注水诊断和闭环油藏动态分析。

details.en: The study extracts field reports, well files, and operational logs into a typed graph, records diagnoses and interventions with expected water-cut responses, and later compares those expectations with production outcomes. It evaluates retrieval, structured reservoir-engineering question answering, agentic memory integrity, and follow-up verdicts at the Wangyao oilfield.
details.zh: 该研究将现场报告、井文件和作业日志提取为类型化图谱，记录诊断和干预措施及预期含水率响应，随后将这些预期与生产结果进行比较。研究在王窑油田评估检索、结构化油藏工程问答、智能体记忆完整性和后续判定。

papers.title: From Text to Simulation: Building EPANET Models from Formalized Network Descriptions with a Local Language Model

summary.en: A software pipeline uses a local LLM to construct and correct EPANET water-distribution-network models from formalized natural-language descriptions.
summary.zh: 一个软件流程使用本地 LLM，根据形式化的自然语言描述构建和校正 EPANET 供水分配网络模型。

details.en: The paper presents HydraKG, which builds EPANET models from tabular or verbal network descriptions, validates the resulting models, and uses an LLM for extraction and correction in the verbal workflow. It evaluates the approach on seven networks, including a real distribution zone.
details.zh: 该论文介绍了 HydraKG，它根据表格或文字形式的网络描述构建 EPANET 模型，验证生成的模型，并在文字工作流中使用 LLM 进行提取和校正。该方法在七个网络上进行了评估，其中包括一个真实的分配区域。

limitations.en: The study was limited by self-generated inputs and shared conventions, controlled rather than independently prepared utility data, networks seen during development, small and uneven run counts, exclusion of L-Town, evaluation of only one LLM and quantization, a mixed-language prompt, incomplete EPANET field coverage, and template-dependent checks that can fail on large or reordered descriptions.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限包括输入由系统自行生成且双方采用相同约定、未使用由公用事业单位独立准备的数据、测试网络在开发阶段已被接触、运行次数少且不均衡、未在口头路径测试L-Town、仅评估了一种大语言模型及量化配置、提示词采用混合语言、未覆盖全部EPANET字段，以及依赖模板且在大型或重排描述上可能失效的检查机制。

papers.title: Construction of a reservoir flood control scheduling knowledge graph through co-creation between large language models and domain experts

summary.en: The paper proposes an expert–LLM co-creation method for constructing a reservoir flood-control scheduling knowledge graph from unstructured documents.
summary.zh: 该论文提出了一种专家–LLM协同创作方法，用于从非结构化文档中构建水库防洪调度知识图谱。

details.en: LECERI combines autonomous LLM-based exploration with expert refinement to improve the accuracy and completeness of a knowledge graph supporting reservoir flood-control scheduling. It reports precision, recall, and F1 scores of 0.52, 0.61, and 0.56.
details.zh: LECERI结合基于LLM的自主探索与专家完善，以提高支持水库防洪调度的知识图谱的准确性和完整性。该方法报告的精确率、召回率和F1分数分别为0.52、0.61和0.56。

papers.title: Post-processing Subglacial Physics Model with Per-site JEPA Specialist Models Enable Natural-language Glaciological Intelligence

summary.en: A preprint analyzes subglacial hydrology and glacier sliding using physics-based simulations and interpretable machine learning, then builds a natural-language glaciological intelligence system with per-glacier JEPA specialists and an agentic LLM router.
summary.zh: 一篇预印本使用基于物理的模拟和可解释机器学习分析冰下水文与冰川滑动，然后构建了一个自然语言冰川学智能系统，该系统配备逐冰川的 JEPA 专家和代理式 LLM 路由器。

details.en: The study examines how subglacial water pressure, bed geometry, meltwater input, and system state relate to glacier sliding across four glaciers. It then uses glacier-specific JEPA representations queried by Claude Sonnet/Opus to retrieve specialist information and improve natural-language answers.
details.zh: 该研究考察了四条冰川中冰下水压、床面几何形态、融水输入和系统状态与冰川滑动之间的关系。随后，研究使用按冰川划分的 JEPA 表征，并通过 Claude Sonnet/Opus 进行查询，以检索专家信息并改进自然语言回答。

limitations.en: The conclusions are limited because the targets are simulator outputs governed by prescribed sliding laws, only four glaciers were analyzed, and the temporal analyses focused on one glacier.
limitations.zh: 研究结论受到以下限制：目标变量来自受预设滑动定律支配的模拟器输出，分析仅涵盖四条冰川，且时间分析集中于一条冰川。

papers.title: GeoAI Platform for Natural Language Exploration of Multidimensional Flood Risk Scenarios

summary.en: A GeoAI platform enables natural-language exploration of multidimensional coastal flood-risk scenarios through a deterministic tool-routed LLM agent and spatially grounded map-chat interface.
summary.zh: GeoAI平台通过确定性工具路由LLM代理和空间定位的地图聊天界面，实现对多维沿海洪水风险情景的自然语言探索。

details.en: The preprint presents a queryable store for 141 flood scenarios and related physical and socioeconomic data, plus an LLM agent that translates compound natural-language planning questions into geospatial tool calls.
details.zh: 该预印本介绍了一个可查询的存储库，其中包含141个洪水情景及相关的物理和社会经济数据，以及一个将复合自然语言规划问题转换为地理空间工具调用的LLM代理。

limitations.en: The platform is limited by the quality and coverage of its underlying models and data, cannot answer beyond modeled scenarios, may propagate modeling errors, missing scenarios, or outdated facility records, can misroute ambiguous queries, and was not evaluated through a participant study of planner choices or time savings.
limitations.zh: 该平台受底层模型和数据的质量与覆盖范围限制，无法回答模型场景之外的问题，可能直接传递建模错误、缺失场景或过时设施记录，可能误解含糊查询，且尚未通过参与者研究评估规划者的选择或节省的时间。

papers.title: Do large language models improve hydrologic model calibration?
Toward Agent-Native Water Systems: A Case Study of the Digital Transformation of a 2,300-square-kilometer Watershed, its Sensors, Dams, and the People Who Control Them

summary.en: A case study of an agentic digital transformation across a large watershed, its dams, sensors, operators, and water-management workflows.
summary.zh: 一个涵盖大型流域、水坝、传感器、操作员和水资源管理工作流程的智能体数字化转型案例研究。

details.en: The paper evaluates agent readiness through field logistics, network automation, stormwater planning, sensor reporting, and audited translation of operator questions into water-modeling workflows.
details.zh: 该论文通过现场物流、网络自动化、雨洪水规划、传感器报告，以及将操作员问题经过审计后转化为水文建模工作流程，评估智能体的就绪程度。

papers.title: Using a Large Language Model for Accurate Technical Language Generation in the Predictive Maintenance of Circulating Water Systems in Nuclear Power Plants
papers.venue: Nuclear Plant Instrumentation and Control & Human-Machine Interface Technology (NPIC&HMIT 2025)

papers.title: Data and code for "Deferring construction, reconsidering reliance: investment sequencing in the Waikato water-supply decision"
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: Data and code supporting an analysis of investment sequencing in the Waikato water-supply decision, including illustrative timing chronologies, successor-attribution comparisons, reproduction scripts, and an analytical figure.
summary.zh: 支持对Waikato供水决策中投资排序进行分析的数据和代码，包括说明性时序编年、后继者归因比较、复现脚本和一幅分析图。

details.en: The release documents assumptions, historical sources, calculations, code, and visualisation for reconstructing the historical design of the 2021–2022 Waikato water-supply decision. The calculations and timing relationships are explicitly illustrative rather than observations of implemented supply or policy outcomes.
details.zh: 该发布内容记录了用于重建2021–2022年Waikato供水决策历史设计的假设、历史来源、计算、代码和可视化。计算和时间关系明确仅为说明性内容，而非对已实施供水或政策结果的观察。

papers.title: Pre-registration: precipitation phase and event streamflow delivery in snow-affected US catchments (p304_phase)
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A preregistration for testing whether rain-versus-snow precipitation changes event-scale streamflow delivery across snow-affected US catchments.
summary.zh: 一份预注册方案，用于检验降雨与降雪降水是否会改变受积雪影响的美国集水区中事件尺度的径流输送。

details.en: The work specifies matched-catchment, within-catchment, and dose-response analyses of 7-, 30-, and 90-day quickflow delivery fractions. It is outcome-blind at deposit, with no snow-versus-rain contrast yet examined. An AI agent wrote and ran the analysis code under a predefined protocol.
details.zh: 该研究规定了对7天、30天和90天快流输送比例进行匹配集水区、集水区内和剂量-反应分析。该研究在存放时对结果不知情，目前尚未检验降雪与降雨之间的对比。一名AI智能体根据预先定义的方案编写并运行了分析代码。

papers.title: Who Gets Help First? A counterfactual audit of large language model decisions in flood response
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A preregistered counterfactual audit of LLM decisions in flood response across languages and affected-population characteristics.
summary.zh: 一项预注册的反事实审计，考察 LLM 在不同语言和受影响人口特征下的洪灾响应决策。

details.en: The study designs 75 flood-response cases in Thessaly, Valais, and Valencia, covering dispatch, evacuation, relief, housing, and triage, to test whether LLM decisions change when affected people, location, or prompt language changes while need remains constant.
details.zh: 该研究在塞萨利、瓦莱州和瓦伦西亚设计了 75 个洪灾响应案例，涵盖调度、疏散、救援、住房和分诊，以检验在需求保持不变的情况下，当受影响人员、地点或提示语言发生变化时，LLM 的决策是否会改变。

papers.title: A Topology-Guided GeoAI Agentic Framework for Urban Flood Screening

summary.en: A topology-guided GeoAI agentic framework uses public geospatial data and explicit spatial analysis to screen urban flood-priority basins, with a language model supporting threshold selection, recommendation drafting, and evidence review.
summary.zh: 一种拓扑引导的 GeoAI 智能体框架利用公共地理空间数据和显式空间分析筛选城市洪涝优先级流域，其中语言模型支持阈值选择、建议起草和证据审查。

details.en: The framework accepts a place name, drawn region, or uploaded boundary; retrieves elevation, rainfall, soil, land-cover, exposure, and infrastructure data; extracts terrain depressions; ranks candidate basins; and provides an interactive map and report. It includes human checkpoints and evaluates basin agreement with a D8 flow-routing model across multiple study areas.
details.zh: 该框架接受地点名称、绘制的区域或上传的边界；检索高程、降雨、土壤、土地覆盖、暴露度和基础设施数据；提取地形洼地；对候选流域进行排序；并提供交互式地图和报告。该框架包含人工检查点，并使用 D8 汇流路由模型在多个研究区域评估流域一致性。

limitations.en: The study is limited by a small number of study areas, U.S.-specific data services, simplified exposure representation, no observed flood events as ground truth, and the potential for LLM-generated recommendations to overstate available evidence.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性包括研究区域数量较少、使用美国特定的数据服务、暴露度表示较为简化、没有以观测洪水事件作为真实基准，以及语言模型生成的建议可能夸大现有证据。

papers.title: Water management in flood-prone areas using nature-based solutions: an AI-assisted systematic review and thematic analysis

summary.en: An AI-assisted systematic review and thematic analysis of nature-based solutions for flood risk reduction and water management.
summary.zh: 一项关于用于降低洪水风险和水管理的基于自然的解决方案的AI辅助系统综述和主题分析。

details.en: The study reviews 185 publications on nature-based solutions in flood-prone areas, using an LLM for screening, structured data extraction, semantic clustering, and evidence synthesis with human validation.
details.zh: 该研究综述了洪水易发地区关于基于自然的解决方案的185篇出版物，使用LLM进行筛选、结构化数据提取、语义聚类和证据综合，并通过人工验证。

limitations.en: The study’s limitations include inconsistent LLM extraction of briefly or indirectly reported qualitative information, technically biased or potentially misclassified thematic clustering, reduced visibility of contradictory or context-specific findings during synthesis, and possible language and model-training bias.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限包括：对于简略或间接报告的定性信息，LLM提取的一致性不足；主题聚类可能存在技术偏向或误分类；综合分析可能弱化相互矛盾或情境特异性结果；以及可能存在语言偏差和模型训练数据偏差。

papers.title: Wastewater surveillance of antimicrobial resistance in human populations: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of the concordance between wastewater and human resistance prevalence — protocol v1.0 and search strategies as executed (PROSPERO CRD420261520110)
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A systematic-review protocol and executed search strategies for assessing concordance between antimicrobial-resistance prevalence in wastewater and human populations, with Claude used in several review-workflow tasks.
summary.zh: 一份系统综述方案及已执行的检索策略，用于评估废水与人群中的抗微生物药物耐药性患病率之间的一致性，其中 Claude 被用于若干综述工作流程任务。

details.en: The deposit specifies the review protocol, database searches, citation tracking, screening procedures, deduplication materials, and planned analysis of wastewater–human AMR concordance. Claude was used for drafting, database-interface operation, deduplication code, and a non-decision-making third title/abstract rating.
details.zh: 该存档说明了综述方案、数据库检索、引文追踪、筛选程序、去重材料，以及对废水–人类 AMR 一致性进行计划中的分析。Claude 被用于起草、数据库界面操作、去重代码，以及第三次不参与决策的标题/摘要评级。

papers.title: IntelliCal Agent (INCA): Code for Diagnosis-Guided Parameter Specification in Hydrologic Models
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: INCA is a diagnostic-reasoning framework that uses multimodal LLMs to generate and evaluate targeted parameter updates in spatially distributed hydrologic models.
summary.zh: INCA 是一种诊断推理框架，使用多模态 LLM 生成并评估空间分布式水文模型中的目标参数更新。

details.en: The work provides source code for an IntelliCal Agent that combines hydrologic diagnostics, parameter semantics, and multimodal LLMs in an iterative reasoning–verification workflow for hydrologic-model parameter specification.
details.zh: 该工作提供了 IntelliCal Agent 的源代码，该智能体在用于水文模型参数指定的迭代推理—验证工作流中，结合了水文诊断、参数语义和多模态 LLM。

papers.title: The Water Sustainability Platform: A Cognitive Multi-agent System for Autonomous Groundwater Oversight

summary.en: A cognitive multi-agent platform for autonomous oversight of groundwater sustainability and regulatory compliance.
summary.zh: 一个用于自主监督地下水可持续性和监管合规的认知多智能体平台。

details.en: The paper presents the Water Sustainability Platform as an autonomous system intended to address limitations of passive SCADA-based hydro-informatics workflows and support oversight of groundwater-related regulatory violations.
details.zh: 该论文介绍了 Water Sustainability Platform，这是一个旨在应对基于被动 SCADA 的水文信息学工作流局限性并支持对地下水相关监管违规行为进行监督的自主系统。

papers.title: FloodVLM-Pix: Language-Guided Pixel-Level Flood Understanding

summary.en: A multimodal flood-understanding preprint that builds a large remote-sensing benchmark and proposes a vision-language model for flood description and pixel-level segmentation.
summary.zh: 一篇多模态洪水理解预印本，构建了一个大型遥感基准，并提出了一个用于洪水描述和像素级分割的视觉语言模型。

details.en: The work introduces a benchmark with flood image patches and textual descriptions of flood severity and evolution, then proposes FloodVLM-Pix with flood-prior and multi-temporal pixel-decoder modules. It evaluates language-level flood description and pixel-level flood segmentation against existing VLMs and flood segmentation models.
details.zh: 该工作引入了一个包含洪水图像块以及洪水严重程度和演变文本描述的基准，随后提出了带有洪水先验和多时相像素解码器模块的 FloodVLM-Pix。该工作将语言级洪水描述和像素级洪水分割与现有 VLM 和洪水分割模型进行了对比评估。

papers.title: Flood risk assessment of stone arch bridges based on large language model and Bayesian Network
Inteligencia artificial para el diseño de humedales artificiales: Chat GPT en soluciones basadas en la naturaleza

summary.en: The paper explores ChatGPT GPT-4o as a design-support tool for preliminary constructed-wetland systems treating domestic greywater.
summary.zh: 该论文探讨了将 ChatGPT GPT-4o 作为设计支持工具，用于处理生活灰水的初步人工湿地系统设计。

details.en: A structured prompt supplied flow, wastewater characteristics, and budget constraints to generate constructed-wetland configurations, materials, vegetation, and operation options. The proposed horizontal subsurface-flow wetland was compared with engineering criteria and specialized literature.
details.zh: 一个结构化提示提供了流量、废水特性和预算限制，以生成人工湿地配置、材料、植被和运行方案。所提出的水平潜流人工湿地与工程标准和专业文献进行了比较。

limitations.en: The study was limited by its reliance on preliminary ChatGPT-generated design recommendations and removal estimates that were not experimentally validated.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于依赖ChatGPT生成的初步设计建议和去除率估计，而这些结果未经实验验证。

papers.title: Enhancing flood resilience in critical communication infrastructures: empirical analysis and software-defined architecture design

summary.en: The paper analyzes how catastrophic floods disrupt critical communication infrastructure and uses LLM-assisted evidence analysis to inform a software-defined 5G resilience architecture.
summary.zh: 该论文分析灾难性洪水如何破坏关键通信基础设施，并利用 LLM 辅助的证据分析为软件定义的 5G 韧性架构提供信息。

details.en: It combines literature, official disaster reports, and interviews to identify communication failure modes in flood scenarios, then maps 5G software-defined capabilities to those flood-related challenges.
details.zh: 该论文结合文献、官方灾害报告和访谈，识别洪水情景下的通信故障模式，然后将 5G 软件定义能力映射到这些与洪水相关的挑战。

papers.title: DriftGuard: an agentic hybrid temporal transformer and graph attention network framework for autonomous calibration drift detection and correction in distributed marine sensor networks

summary.en: DriftGuard is an autonomous framework for detecting and correcting calibration drift in distributed marine sensor networks using graph-temporal modeling, uncertainty estimation, and an LLM-driven agentic workflow.
summary.zh: DriftGuard 是一个自主框架，利用图时序建模、不确定性估计和 LLM 驱动的智能体工作流，检测并校正分布式海洋传感器网络中的校准漂移。

details.en: The paper evaluates DriftGuard on Argo float profiles, NDBC buoy time series, and the AdapAD benchmark. Its pipeline combines a heterogeneous sensor graph, a Hybrid Temporal Transformer and Graph Attention Network, cross-sensor consistency loss, conformal prediction, and a LangGraph-orchestrated agentic loop with RAG support for autonomous correction and operational sensor-state decisions.
details.zh: 该论文在 Argo 浮标剖面、NDBC 浮标时间序列和 AdapAD 基准数据集上评估 DriftGuard。其流程结合了异构传感器图、Hybrid Temporal Transformer 和 Graph Attention Network、跨传感器一致性损失、保形预测，以及由 LangGraph 编排并由 RAG 提供支持的智能体循环，用于自主校正和运行中的传感器状态决策。

limitations.en: The study acknowledges that performance is weakest for sparsely connected sensors in undersampled regions, step-drift detection remains slightly slower than Argo QC Test 16, the 800-km graph threshold is an engineering choice, conformal guarantees are marginal rather than class-conditional, and feedback evaluation was limited to four events with two real-LLM verification cases falling back to a deterministic oracle because of API rate limits.
limitations.zh: 该研究承认，其对稀疏连接传感器及采样不足区域的性能最弱，阶跃漂移检测仍略慢于 Argo QC Test 16，800 公里的图连接阈值属于工程选择，保形保证仅为边际保证而非条件保证，且反馈评估仅涵盖四个事件，并因 API 速率限制导致其中两个真实 LLM 验证案例回退到确定性预设程序。

papers.title: Source-discrimination feedback for large language model agents in river pollution source identification

summary.en: A source-discrimination feedback method guides an LLM agent to identify pollution sources and select additional observations in branching river networks.
summary.zh: 源判别反馈方法指导 LLM agent 识别污染源，并在分支河网中选择额外观测。

details.en: The preprint links a hydrodynamic–water-quality model to a ReAct-based LLM agent that retains source hypotheses and compares predicted differences at unused observation blocks. It evaluates the approach on synthetic river pollution events against ordinary ReAct, fixed observation plans, and a deterministic selector.
details.zh: 该预印本将水动力–水质模型与基于 ReAct 的 LLM agent 连接起来，后者保留源假设，并比较未使用观测块处的预测差异。该方法在合成河流污染事件上进行了评估，并与普通 ReAct、固定观测计划和确定性选择器进行了对比。

papers.title: Reconstructing flood-induced human mobility using LLM agent with disaster context adaptation
papers.venue: Transportation Research Part D Transport and Environment

summary.en: An LLM-agent framework reconstructs individual mobility trajectories during urban floods to support evacuation analysis and flood-resilient transport planning.
summary.zh: 一种LLM代理框架重构城市洪灾期间的个体出行轨迹，以支持疏散分析和抗洪交通规划。

details.en: The Disaster-aware Trajectory Generator combines LLM agents with an agent-based framework and evaluates flood-induced mobility patterns using 1.32 billion records from the 2021 Zhengzhou flood.
details.zh: 灾害感知轨迹生成器将LLM代理与基于代理的框架相结合，并利用2021年郑州洪灾期间的13.2亿条记录评估洪灾引发的出行模式。

papers.title: Language model agents find polluted water but rarely locate its source
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A benchmark study of language-model agents for detecting polluted water and locating its source.
summary.zh: 一项用于检测污染水并定位其来源的语言模型智能体基准研究。

details.en: The archive provides fixed-field benchmark software and task files, including source-present and control tasks, environmental-condition transformations, evaluator answers, scoring, replay validation, and baseline controllers.
details.zh: 该存档提供固定字段的基准软件和任务文件，包括源存在任务和对照任务、环境条件变换、评估器答案、评分、回放验证以及基线控制器。

papers.title: HydroPrior: Offline LLM-Prior-Guided Residual Warning for Hydropower Bearing Vibration

summary.en: A hydropower bearing-vibration early-warning method that uses offline LLM-derived operating-context features with residual forecasting and calibrated alerting.
summary.zh: 一种水电轴承振动预警方法，使用离线 LLM 派生的运行上下文特征，结合残差预测和校准告警。

details.en: HydroPrior combines frozen LLM priors with lightweight residual-based warning, evaluates forecasting error and proxy-event warning performance, and reports results on a public hydropower bearing-vibration dataset.
details.zh: HydroPrior 将冻结的 LLM 先验与轻量级基于残差的预警相结合，评估预测误差和代理事件预警性能，并在一个公开的水电轴承振动数据集上报告结果。

papers.title: 19 pre-registered predictions on the 2026–27 El Niño season in the Zambezi basin, committed by hash
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A pre-registered set of 19 probabilistic predictions for the 2026–27 El Niño season in the Zambezi basin, including hydrological operations and drought-related outcomes, developed and critiqued with AI agents.
summary.zh: 针对赞比西河流域2026–27年厄尔尼诺季节的19项概率预测预注册集合，涵盖水文运行和与干旱相关的结果，并由AI代理制定和批评。

details.en: The record commits hashed prediction files in advance and specifies later publication and scoring procedures. Predictions cover Lake Kariba water releases for power, drought declarations, ENSO readings, humanitarian responses, financing, insurance, and cross-system connections. Claude-based agents wrote and challenged each prediction and read source material used for lags, effect sizes, and base rates.
details.zh: 该记录提前提交带哈希的预测文件，并规定后续发布和评分程序。预测涵盖卡里巴湖发电用水释放、干旱声明、ENSO读数、人道主义响应、融资、保险以及跨系统联系。基于Claude的代理撰写并质疑每项预测，并阅读了用于确定滞后期、效应量和基准发生率的资料。

papers.title: Equitable supply in water distribution networks using data-driven optimization and AI-assisted voice automation

summary.en: The work clearly targets equitable water supply in water distribution networks, but the metadata does not establish whether the AI-assisted voice automation is an LLM or a substantive language-driven agent.
summary.zh: 该工作明确以供水管网中的公平供水为目标，但元数据未确定AI辅助语音自动化是否为LLM或实质性的语言驱动代理。

details.en: The title describes equitable water distribution using data-driven optimization and AI-assisted voice automation.
details.zh: 标题描述了使用数据驱动优化和AI辅助语音自动化实现公平供水。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its laboratory-scale testbed, which does not reproduce the scale, leakage, infrastructure condition, or operational uncertainty of field networks; it also uses binary valves and an open-loop schedule with fixed demands, evaluates only two shortfall conditions, does not experimentally characterize all valve states, and tests the voice interface only under limited speaker, dialect, and acoustic conditions.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于其实验室规模测试平台无法再现现场网络的规模、漏损、基础设施状况或运行不确定性；此外，研究采用二元阀门和基于固定需求的开环调度，仅评估了两种供水短缺情形，未对所有阀门状态进行实验表征，且语音接口仅在有限的说话者、方言和声学条件下进行了测试。

papers.title: AutoCF: An Automated LLM-Assisted Ecosystem for Compound Flood Simulation, Evaluation, and Impact Attribution

summary.en: AutoCF is presented as an automated ecosystem for compound coastal-flood simulation, evaluation, exposure analysis, driver attribution, and cross-platform execution, with Hurricane Harvey as the demonstrated case.
summary.zh: AutoCF 被介绍为一个用于复合型沿海洪水模拟、评估、暴露分析、驱动因素归因和跨平台执行的自动化生态系统，并以 Hurricane Harvey 作为示范案例。

details.en: The work reports flood-simulation accuracy against gauges and high-water marks, CPU/GPU agreement, and attribution of precipitation and coastal forcing to inundation and societal exposure. The title claims LLM assistance, but the supplied abstract does not describe that assistance.
details.zh: 该工作报告了基于测站和高水位标记的洪水模拟准确性、CPU/GPU 一致性，以及对降水和沿海强迫对淹没和社会暴露影响的归因。标题声称有 LLM 辅助，但所提供的摘要未描述这种辅助。

limitations.en: The study is limited by aggregating coastal water level, wind, and atmospheric pressure into one driver, the rapidly increasing computational cost of exact attribution with more drivers, uncertainty in building and population exposure data, U.S.-specific SVI coverage, possible mismatches between present-day terrain and historical event conditions, the absence of satellite-based inundation evaluation, and resolution- and data-quality dependence of the reported results.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性包括将沿海水位、风和大气压力合并为一个驱动因素、增加驱动因素时精确归因的计算成本会迅速上升、建筑物和人口暴露数据存在不确定性、社会脆弱性指数仅适用于美国、现今地形与历史事件条件可能不一致、尚未纳入基于卫星的淹没范围评估，以及报告结果依赖于空间分辨率和数据质量。

papers.title: Agent-assisted modeling for urban drainage systems

summary.en: Introduces SWMM-MCP, an MCP-based framework that lets users operate EPA SWMM through natural language and evaluates it with eight base LLMs.
summary.zh: 介绍了 SWMM-MCP，这是一个基于 MCP 的框架，使用户能够通过自然语言操作 EPA SWMM，并使用八个基础 LLM 对其进行评估。

details.en: The paper addresses domain-specific stormwater modeling by connecting LLMs to SWMM through swmm_api, PySWMM, and an MCP server. It evaluates benchmark task completion, computational efficiency, response detail, and prompt-response behavior across eight LLMs.
details.zh: 该论文通过 swmm_api、PySWMM 和 MCP 服务器将 LLM 连接到 SWMM，以解决特定领域的雨水建模问题。论文评估了八个 LLM 在基准任务完成情况、计算效率、响应详细程度以及提示-响应行为方面的表现。

papers.title: Making waves: Human-governed workflow logic for agentic AI in water management

summary.en: Perspective on human-governed agentic workflows for water management, with a 158-question reservoir-regulation evaluation comparing Native RAG and Agentic RAG using Qwen3.6–27B.
summary.zh: 关于水资源管理中人类治理的智能体工作流的观点，包含一项158个问题的水库调度评估，对比了 Native RAG 和 Agentic RAG，使用 Qwen3.6–27B。

details.en: The paper argues that execution trajectories and human governance can support reusable agent skills and workflow controllers in water management. Section 2 reports a controlled comparison using the same local reservoir-regulation knowledge base and quantised Qwen3.6–27B model. Across 158 questions, Agentic RAG reportedly improves evidence completeness from 81% to 100% and answer accuracy from 42% to 92%, while first-response time increases from 18.2 s to 27–28 s. The broader skill-learning loop and urban flood response pathway are proposed frameworks rather than demonstrated deployed systems.
details.zh: 论文认为，执行轨迹和人类治理能够支持水资源管理中可复用的智能体技能和工作流控制器。第2节报告了一项受控对比，使用相同的本地水库调度知识库和量化的 Qwen3.6–27B 模型。在158个问题中，据报告，Agentic RAG 将证据完整性从81%提高到100%，将答案准确率从42%提高到92%，而首次响应时间从18.2 s增加到27–28 s。更广泛的技能学习循环和城市洪水响应路径被提出为框架，而非已部署并得到验证的系统。

papers.title: LeakAgent: a multi-agent system for leak detection using multi-modal large language model coordination in water distribution network

summary.en: A multi-agent LLM-coordinated system jointly detects leaks and identifies affected partitions in water distribution networks.
summary.zh: 一个由LLM协调的多智能体系统联合检测漏损并识别供水管网中受影响的分区。

details.en: The paper integrates hydraulic pressure-sensitivity information, network zoning, sensor placement, graph-based leak detection, and autonomous fault repair within an LLM-coordinated multi-agent workflow, evaluated across five water distribution networks.
details.zh: 该论文将水力压力敏感性信息、管网分区、传感器布置、基于图的漏损检测和自主故障修复集成到由LLM协调的多智能体工作流中，并在五个供水管网上进行了评估。

limitations.en: The study is limited to partition-level rather than node- or pipe-level localization, may face computational-scaling challenges on much larger networks, involves commercial-coordinator costs and data-sovereignty concerns, does not cover time-varying demand regimes or several long-term and asset-record uncertainties, and uses sensor placement optimized by a detectability surrogate decoupled from the LTGFM detector.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限在于仅能进行分区级而非节点级或管道级定位，在更大规模网络上可能面临计算扩展挑战，涉及商业协调器的成本和数据主权问题，未涵盖时变需求状况及若干长期和资产记录不确定性，并且传感器布置基于与LTGFM检测器相互独立的可检测性替代指标进行优化。

papers.title: Assessing flood-related wellbeing from public discourse in Ireland using large language model as judge, 2012--2025

summary.en: The preprint develops an LLM-based pipeline to measure flood-related wellbeing from public discourse in Ireland over 2012–2025.
summary.zh: 该预印本开发了一套基于LLM的流程，用于衡量2012–2025年间爱尔兰公共话语中与洪水相关的福祉。

details.en: It introduces a flood-wellbeing instrument covering distress appraisal, perceived efficacy and agency, and relational-institutional connectedness, then uses large language models to extract these measures at scale and analyze stressor activation and mediation pathways.
details.zh: 该研究介绍了一种涵盖痛苦评估、感知效能与能动性，以及关系—制度联结的洪水福祉测量工具，随后利用大型语言模型大规模提取这些测量指标，并分析压力源激活和中介路径。

limitations.en: Because unobtrusive discourse data lack respondents’ pre-disaster baselines, clinical histories, and longitudinal psychological profiles, the instrument cannot produce continuous psychometric severity estimates comparable to questionnaire-based scales, and the flood-event multiplicity counts are acknowledged as best-effort and illustrative.
limitations.zh: 由于非介入式话语数据缺乏受访者灾前基线、临床病史和纵向心理档案，该工具无法产生可与问卷量表相比较的连续心理测量严重程度估计，而且文中承认洪水事件的多重计数仅是尽力整理且具有示意性。

papers.title: An Evidence-Constrained RAG Learning Support System for Interdisciplinary Smart Water Engineering Education: Multi-Source Knowledge Governance and Reproducible Technical Evaluation

summary.en: The paper develops and technically evaluates an evidence-constrained RAG learning-support system for interdisciplinary smart water engineering education.
summary.zh: 该论文开发并从技术上评估了一个受证据约束的RAG学习支持系统，用于跨学科智慧水务工程教育。

details.en: It governs and retrieves multi-source hydrological, hydraulic, standards, model, and software knowledge, then evaluates retrieval quality and refusal behavior on frozen benchmarks.
details.zh: 该系统管理并检索多源水文、水力、标准、模型和软件知识，然后在冻结基准测试上评估检索质量和拒答行为。

papers.title: Pallade Idrico: A Zero-Loss Hybrid RAG-LLM Architecture for Economic Regulation and Governance of the Italian Integrated Water Service
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A hybrid RAG-LLM system specialized for economic regulation, compliance, and governance of Italy’s Integrated Water Service.
summary.zh: 一个专门用于意大利综合供水服务经济监管、合规与治理的混合 RAG-LLM 系统。

details.en: The report presents Pallade Idrico, a fine-tuned Italian LLM combined with a regulatory-document ingestion, hierarchical-temporal reranking, and retrieval pipeline. It evaluates the system on water-service tariffs, technical quality, metering, and user-protection regulations, with automated testing by a Gemini-based AI agent.
details.zh: 该报告介绍了 Pallade Idrico，这是一个经过微调的意大利语 LLM，与监管文件摄取、分层时间重排序和检索管道相结合。报告围绕供水服务费率、技术质量、计量和用户保护法规对该系统进行评估，并由基于 Gemini 的 AI 智能体进行自动化测试。

papers.title: Photothermal‐Seek: Literature‐Grounded Knowledge Graphs for Discovering High‐Performance Solar Evaporators

summary.en: A literature-grounded knowledge graph uses LLM-assisted extraction and reasoning to discover and evaluate high-performance solar interfacial evaporators for desalination and water purification.
summary.zh: 一个以文献为基础的知识图谱使用LLM辅助提取和推理，发现并评估用于海水淡化和水净化的高性能太阳能界面蒸发器。

details.en: The paper presents Photothermal-Seek, built from 2771 publications, to connect synthesis, structure, and performance information for solar interfacial evaporation materials. It combines LLM-assisted extraction, graph reasoning, and full-text evidence retrieval, then uses the resulting knowledge base to guide the construction and testing of a polypyrrole-coated wood evaporator and assess an unseen design.
details.zh: 论文介绍了Photothermal-Seek，该系统基于2771篇出版物构建，用于连接太阳能界面蒸发材料的合成、结构和性能信息。它结合了LLM辅助提取、图推理和全文证据检索，然后利用所得知识库指导聚吡咯涂层木材蒸发器的构建和测试，并评估一种未见过的设计。

papers.title: 地热计算器专业版-GGS
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A geothermal simulation software artifact that supports AI-Agent-assisted modeling alongside geothermal flow, heat-transfer, and resource-assessment capabilities.
summary.zh: 一种地热模拟软件成果，支持AI-Agent辅助建模，以及地热流动、传热和资源评估功能。

details.en: GGS provides geological and fracture-network modeling, hydrothermal geothermal simulation, CO₂ storage and compositional simulation, dynamic geothermal resource assessment, and AI-Agent-assisted modeling.
details.zh: GGS提供地质和裂缝网络建模、水热地热模拟、CO₂储存和组分模拟、动态地热资源评估以及AI-Agent辅助建模。

papers.title: Separating Runtime Acceptance from Offline Contract Alignment in LLM-Orchestrated Flood GIS Workflows: A Dual-Case Evaluation

summary.en: Evaluates GeoFloodAgent, an LLM-orchestrated flood-GIS workflow, using dual-case flood tasks and contract-alignment metrics.
summary.zh: 评估 GeoFloodAgent（一种由 LLM 编排的洪水 GIS 工作流），使用双案例洪水任务和契约对齐指标。

details.en: The paper evaluates runtime acceptance and post-run alignment with product, lineage, and action contracts across Chinese-language Zhengzhou and Forlì flood cases. It also tests configuration sensitivity of deterministic SAR-based flood extent processing and cautions that completion rate alone is insufficient for evaluating LLM-orchestrated flood GIS.
details.zh: 该论文评估了中文郑州和 Forlì 洪水案例中运行时的接受情况，以及运行后与产品、溯源和行动契约的对齐情况。该论文还测试了基于确定性 SAR 的洪水范围处理的配置敏感性，并指出，仅凭完成率不足以评估由 LLM 编排的洪水 GIS。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its synthetic, finite 80-task benchmark and shared implementation lineage, limited geographic and operational diversity, use of a hosted endpoint with unavailable version history, inseparable registry-remediation and execution-time effects, and lack of independent hydrological or operational validation and human-centered outcome measures.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于采用了合成且有限的80项任务基准及具有共同实现谱系的组件，地理和业务多样性有限，使用版本历史不可得的托管端点，无法区分注册表修正与执行时间效应，并且缺乏独立的水文或业务有效性验证以及以人为中心的结果指标。

papers.title: HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks

summary.en: The preprint proposes a fast, training-free first-tier screen for attributing cyberattacks, physical faults, transients, and sensor faults in water distribution network SCADA alarms, with LLMs used as benchmarked reviewers in a gated triage cascade.
summary.zh: 该预印本提出了一种快速、无需训练的一级初筛方法，用于在供水管网 SCADA 报警中归因网络攻击、物理故障、瞬态事件和传感器故障，并将 LLM 用作经过基准测试的审查器，置于门控式分诊级联中。

details.en: It evaluates Jev, rules, a supervised classifier, and seven cloud LLMs on C-Town and additional EPANET water networks, reporting attribution performance, speed, and reduced LLM review workload.
details.zh: 该研究在 C-Town 及其他 EPANET 供水网络上评估了 Jev、规则、一个监督分类器和七个云端 LLM，并报告了归因性能、速度以及减少的 LLM 审查工作量。

limitations.en: The study was limited by its reliance on simulated windows generated from a single hydraulic model, cloud-LLM weights and serving conditions that may change without notice with latency measured only at one time, the benign gate’s ability to accept attacks missed by both judges, Jev’s difficulty with concealed manipulation and Net1 bursts, the frontier LLMs’ higher accuracy, and lower gate precision and no improvement from the ungated rule cascade in some unseen settings.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于依赖由单一水力模型生成的模拟窗口，云端大语言模型的权重和服务条件可能在无预警下变化且延迟仅在一个时间点测量，良性门控可能接受两个判断器都漏判的攻击，Jev难以识别隐蔽操纵和Net1中的爆管，前沿大语言模型准确率更高，以及在部分未见场景中门控精确率较低且无门控规则级联未带来改进。

papers.title: Development of an Agent-Powered Decision Support System for Real-Time Flood Control Consultation at the Xiaolangdi Reservoir

summary.en: An LLM- and multi-agent-powered RAG decision support system for real-time flood control consultation at the Xiaolangdi Reservoir.
summary.zh: 一个由LLM和多智能体驱动的RAG决策支持系统，用于Xiaolangdi Reservoir的实时防洪会商。

details.en: The paper develops and deploys a flood-control consultation platform that coordinates specialized agents, retrieves historical flood cases and technical specifications, analyzes real-time hydrological information, and generates operational recommendations consistent with reservoir safety requirements.
details.zh: 该论文开发并部署了一个防洪会商平台，该平台协调专业化智能体，检索历史洪水案例和技术规范，分析实时水文信息，并生成符合水库安全要求的运行建议。

limitations.en: The study is limited by a Xiaolangdi-only knowledge base and evaluation, incomplete integration of real-time meteorological forecasting, an unvalidated simulation model under extreme floods, dependence of LLM reasoning on retrieved context with potentially suboptimal recommendations for unprecedented scenarios, and support only for single-reservoir consultation without cascade coordination.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限性包括知识库和评估仅覆盖小浪底水库、实时气象预报尚未完全接入、仿真模型尚未在极端洪水条件下得到验证、语言模型推理依赖检索上下文且在缺乏历史先例的情景下可能产生次优建议，以及目前仅支持单水库咨询而不支持梯级水库协同。

papers.title: A SURVEY AND COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS OF LEAD IN DRINKING WATER POLICIES IN THE AMERICAS

summary.en: Comparative assessment of lead-in-drinking-water policies across 28 countries in the Americas, identifying regulatory strengths and gaps.
summary.zh: 对美洲28个国家饮用水中铅相关政策的比较评估，识别监管优势与缺口。

details.en: The study evaluates monitoring, lead-source elimination, budgets, plumbing regulations, and policy environments, finding persistent gaps in enforcement and actionable lead-elimination measures.
details.zh: 该研究评估了监测、铅源消除、预算、管道法规和政策环境，发现执法以及可操作的铅消除措施方面仍存在持续性缺口。

papers.title: Visual narratives of disaster on Instagram: a multimodal AI-assisted analysis

summary.en: The paper uses ChatGPT-4 to analyze visual and emotional narratives in Instagram posts about the 2021 western Germany floods, supporting large-scale assessment of disaster impacts and recovery discourse.
summary.zh: 该论文使用 ChatGPT-4 分析关于2021年德国西部洪灾的 Instagram 帖子中的视觉和情感叙事，为大规模评估灾害影响和恢复话语提供支持。

details.en: Approximately 2,700 Instagram posts were analyzed using human-supervised ChatGPT-4 image interpretation, manual validation, thematic classification, emotional analysis, and hashtag examination across flood response and recovery phases.
details.zh: 使用人工监督的 ChatGPT-4 图像解读、人工验证、主题分类、情感分析和主题标签考察，对约2,700条 Instagram 帖子进行了分析，涵盖洪灾响应和恢复阶段。

limitations.en: The study is limited because its Instagram corpus was retrieved using only three event-related hashtags and constrained by API and algorithmic filtering, so its findings reflect those hashtags rather than the full range of disaster-related content on Instagram.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限在于其 Instagram 数据集仅通过三个灾害相关标签获取，并受到 API 和算法筛选的限制，因此研究结果反映的是这些标签下的内容，而非 Instagram 上全部灾害相关内容。

papers.title: Regional Groundwater Database for Arequipa and Surroundings in Southern Peru from Unstructured Sources Using an Integrated Optical Character Recognition and Large Language Model Workflow

summary.en: A regional groundwater database for southern Peru is constructed from unstructured documents and monitoring data using OCR, a large language model, and human verification.
summary.zh: 利用 OCR、大语言模型和人工验证，从非结构化文档和监测数据中构建了一个秘鲁南部区域地下水数据库。

details.en: The work recovers and validates 4,775 georeferenced groundwater records from 3,675 documents, including hydraulic and geological parameters, and evaluates transcription fidelity and data-reuse risks.
details.zh: 该研究从 3,675 份文档中恢复并验证了 4,775 条地理参考地下水记录，包括水文地质和地质参数，并评估了转录保真度和数据再利用风险。

limitations.en: The study is limited by incomplete and variable-quality source materials, including missing or estimated values and unavailable proprietary data, evolving measurement protocols, spatial clustering that under-represents remote high-altitude areas, Spanish-language OCR artefacts, imperfect extraction completeness, scarce source redundancy, and a heterogeneous conductivity column that mixes measurement supports.
limitations.zh: 该研究受到原始资料不完整且质量不一（包括缺失或估算值以及无法获得的专有数据）、测量规范随时间变化、空间聚集导致偏远高海拔地区代表性不足、西班牙语 OCR 伪影、提取完整性不完美、来源间重复记录稀少，以及电导率列混合不同测量支持方式等因素的限制。

papers.title: Evaluating Modern Tools and Large Language Models for Digitising Sea-Level Data from Marigrams

summary.en: The preprint evaluates conventional digitisation tools and two large language models for recovering historical sea-level observations from marigrams.
summary.zh: 该预印本评估了传统数字化工具和两个大型语言模型从潮位计图中恢复历史海平面观测值的能力。

details.en: A multi-user framework compares 11 digitisation tools and two LLMs on a week-long marigram from the Clyde Estuary. The LLMs exceeded 10% of the observed tidal range in error, while most conventional tools achieved errors below 1%.
details.zh: 一个多用户框架在来自克莱德河口、持续一周的潮位计图上比较了11种数字化工具和两个LLM。LLM的误差超过观测潮差的10%，而大多数传统工具的误差低于1%。

limitations.en: The study was limited by evaluating only a single marigram, using a relatively small number of participants, and restricting data extraction to 15-minute intervals, which may have understated the advantages of trace tools.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于仅评估了一张潮汐曲线图、参与者数量相对较少，并将数据提取限制在15分钟间隔，这可能低估了轨迹工具的优势。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal coupling between physical disaster impacts and social sentiment in urban flood events using large language models
papers.venue: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction

papers.title: A method for generating urban flood control emergency plans based on large language models and graph retrieval enhancement

summary.en: A graph-retrieval-enhanced LLM framework generates and optimizes urban flood control emergency plans.
summary.zh: 一种图检索增强的LLM框架生成并优化城市洪涝防控应急预案。

details.en: The paper constructs a flood-control knowledge graph, uses LLMs for backward-reasoning question generation and structured plan generation, and evaluates a closed-loop workflow against standalone LLMs and traditional RAG methods.
details.zh: 该论文构建了一个防洪知识图谱，使用LLM进行反向推理问题生成和结构化预案生成，并将闭环工作流与独立LLM和传统RAG方法进行评估。

papers.title: Predictors and Orchestrators: Parsimonious Machine Learning within an Agentic AI Harness for Multi-Horizon Karst Aquifer Forecasting

summary.en: A deployment-aware framework forecasts karst aquifer discharge and groundwater levels over 1–12 weeks and embeds the validated predictors in a five-agent operational architecture.
summary.zh: 一种具备部署感知能力的框架可预测喀斯特含水层未来1–12周的出流量和地下水位，并将经过验证的预测器嵌入五智能体运行架构中。

details.en: The study evaluates several machine-learning model families on approximately 79 years of Edwards Aquifer observations, finding extreme gradient boosting most reliable across forecast horizons. A five-agent architecture automates the operational forecasting and reporting workflow.
details.zh: 该研究基于Edwards Aquifer约79年的观测数据评估了多个机器学习模型系列，发现极端梯度提升模型在各预测时段均最为可靠。五智能体架构可自动完成运行预测和报告工作流程。

limitations.en: The study is limited to two indicators from one karst system, has limited support for rare CS4–CS5 events and an insufficiently large initial prospective sample, relies on operational meteorological forcing only for week 1 and persistence estimates thereafter, and does not yet ensure fully reliable autonomous execution without additional engineering hardening.
limitations.zh: 该研究仅限于一个岩溶系统的两个指标，对罕见的CS4–CS5事件支持有限，初始前瞻性样本规模不足，运行中的气象强迫仅覆盖第1周、之后依赖持续性估计，且在进一步工程强化之前尚不能确保自主执行的完全可靠性。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Vision-Language Inference for Image-Based Urban Flood Depth Estimation

summary.en: FloodVision uses a knowledge-guided vision-language model to estimate urban floodwater depth from single RGB images.
summary.zh: FloodVision 使用知识引导的视觉语言模型，根据单张 RGB 图像估计城市洪水水深。

details.en: The preprint introduces FloodVision, which combines a general-purpose VLM with FloodKG, a knowledge base of canonical object dimensions and component landmarks, to provide geometrically grounded flood-depth estimates. It evaluates the approach on 654 crowdsourced urban flood images and reports lower errors than a VLM-only baseline.
details.zh: 该预印本介绍了 FloodVision，它将通用 VLM 与 FloodKG 相结合。FloodKG 是一个包含规范物体尺寸和组件地标的知识库，用于提供具有几何依据的洪水深度估计。该方法在 654 张众包城市洪水图像上进行了评估，结果显示其误差低于仅使用 VLM 的基线方法。

limitations.en: The framework relies on visible reference objects or components, so severe occlusion can reduce estimation accuracy, and its primarily generic FloodKG may not capture regional variability in flood scenes.
limitations.zh: 该框架依赖可见的参考物体或组件，因此严重遮挡可能降低估计准确性，而其主要包含通用信息的 FloodKG 可能无法反映洪水场景中的区域差异。

papers.title: Field photography and satellite radar for verifying alternate wetting and drying in Balinese subaks: data, code and figures
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A hydro-focused research artifact on verifying alternate wetting and drying irrigation in Balinese rice terraces using farmer photographs and satellite radar, with a vision-capable language model classifying the photographs.
summary.zh: 一项以水文为重点的研究成果，用于利用农民拍摄的照片和卫星雷达验证巴厘岛水稻梯田中的交替湿润与干燥灌溉，并使用具备视觉能力的语言模型对照片进行分类。

details.en: The deposit contains data, analysis code, figures, field boundaries, language-model photographic classifications and reasoning text, classifier reliability analysis, and Sentinel-1/NISAR radar extractions. It evaluates field- and community-scale detection of synchronized drying and documents radar and threshold-related effects.
details.zh: 该存档包含数据、分析代码、图表、田块边界、语言模型对照片的分类结果及推理文本、分类器可靠性分析，以及 Sentinel-1/NISAR 雷达提取结果。该研究评估了田块和社区尺度上对同步干燥的检测，并记录了雷达和阈值相关的影响。

papers.title: Improving multi-factor river water quality prediction using deep learning and large language models with retrieval-augmented generation

summary.en: A hydro-focused framework combines deep learning, retrieval-augmented LLMs, and a RAG-enhanced multi-agent system for river water-quality prediction, classification, and management recommendations.
summary.zh: 一个以水文为重点的框架结合深度学习、检索增强型LLM以及RAG增强的多智能体系统，用于河流水质预测、分类和管理建议。

details.en: The study integrates water-quality, meteorological, socio-economic, and hydro-topographic data to predict six river water-quality indicators with a CNN-LSTM-attention model. Literature-based retrieval helps configure hyperparameters, while an LLM-enabled multi-agent system performs water-quality grade classification and generates improvement recommendations using domain knowledge and expert experience.
details.zh: 该研究整合水质、气象、社会经济和水文地形数据，使用CNN-LSTM-attention模型预测六项河流水质指标。基于文献的检索有助于配置超参数，同时，LLM支持的多智能体系统利用领域知识和专家经验执行水质等级分类并生成改善建议。

papers.title: Auditable Automation of Activated Sludge Modeling for Wastewater Treatment Diagnosis Using LLM-Agents

summary.en: A paper presents an auditable LLM-Agent workflow for configuring, executing, and calibrating activated sludge models for wastewater treatment diagnosis.
summary.zh: 一篇论文介绍了一种可审计的 LLM-Agent 工作流，用于配置、执行和校准活性污泥模型，以进行废水处理诊断。

details.en: AutoWWTP-ASM translates wastewater-process descriptions into structured, library-constrained activated sludge model configurations, supports execution and calibration, and evaluates multiple LLM backbones, agent modules, deployment settings, standardized BSM1 scenarios, and full-scale WWTP data.
details.zh: AutoWWTP-ASM 将废水处理过程描述转换为受库约束的结构化活性污泥模型配置，支持执行和校准，并评估多种 LLM 主干、智能体模块、部署设置、标准化 BSM1 场景和全规模 WWTP 数据。

papers.title: Sparse validation can mask process errors in urban flood modelling: evidence from large multimodal model-assisted video observations

summary.en: A preprint evaluates whether sparse peak-depth validation can detect process errors in an urban flood model using minute-level inundation observations derived from videos with large multimodal model assistance.
summary.zh: 一篇预印本评估了稀疏峰值水深验证能否利用大型多模态模型辅助从视频中获取的分钟级积水观测结果，检测城市洪水模型中的过程错误。

details.en: The study calibrates and validates a 1D–2D MIKE FLOOD model for Dalian, China, then compares simulations with 20,825 video-derived inundation levels. It quantifies errors in occurrence, timing, severity, and duration and finds substantial process-fidelity errors despite low peak-depth RMSEs.
details.zh: 该研究针对中国大连校准并验证了1D–2D MIKE FLOOD模型，然后将模拟结果与20,825个视频推导的积水水位进行比较。研究量化了发生、时间、严重程度和持续时间方面的误差，并发现尽管峰值水深RMSE较低，过程保真度仍存在显著误差。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its targeted camera sample from known waterlogging hotspots, the ordinal scale’s inability to resolve within-class water-depth differences, and CLMMs that provide diagnostic associations rather than causal decomposition.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限性在于摄像机样本针对已知积水热点、序数量表无法解析类别内的水深差异，以及累积链接混合模型只能提供诊断性关联而非因果分解。

papers.title: Scientific capabilities and deployment sustainability of small-scale LLMs in biological wastewater treatment

summary.en: The preprint evaluates a domain-specialized small LLM for scientific reasoning and sustainable deployment in biological wastewater treatment, including hypothesis generation and wastewater-treatment-plant deployment analysis.
summary.zh: 该预印本评估了一个面向领域的轻量级LLM在生物废水处理中的科学推理能力和可持续部署，包括假设生成和废水处理厂部署分析。

details.en: BioWater, an 8-billion-parameter LLM fine-tuned on wastewater-treatment knowledge, is benchmarked on retrospective cognition, comprehension fidelity, and prospective extrapolation. The study also reports human–LLM hypothesis generation supported by laboratory experiments and compares the sustainability of local small-scale versus cloud-based large-scale LLM deployment across global wastewater treatment plants.
details.zh: BioWater是一个拥有80亿参数、在废水处理知识上进行微调的LLM，研究对其回顾性认知、理解保真度和前瞻性外推能力进行了基准测试。该研究还报告了由实验室实验支持的人类–LLM假设生成，并比较了全球废水处理厂中本地小规模与基于云的大规模LLM部署的可持续性。

limitations.en: The study’s evaluations do not cover the full diversity of biological wastewater-treatment problems or BioWater’s performance with unfamiliar configurations, incomplete or noisy data, and knowledge beyond its fine-tuning corpus; it assesses mainly a single model rather than multi-agent architectures, relies on assumption-based sustainability estimates whose crossover frequencies are sensitive to contextual parameters, and does not independently separate model-scale from deployment-architecture effects.
limitations.zh: 该研究的评估未涵盖生物废水处理问题的全部多样性，也未系统评估BioWater在陌生工艺配置、不完整或噪声运行数据以及超出其微调语料知识范围情况下的表现；研究主要评估单一模型而非多智能体架构，且可持续性估算依赖假设、其交叉频率易受具体参数影响，同时未独立区分模型规模与部署架构的影响。

papers.title: Case-knowledge-guided construction-phase safety appraisal report generation for hydraulic and hydropower projects using large language models

summary.en: An LLM-based, case-knowledge-guided workflow generates auditable construction-phase safety appraisal reports for hydraulic and hydropower projects.
summary.zh: 一种基于LLM、案例知识引导的工作流，可为水利水电项目生成可审计的施工阶段安全评价报告。

details.en: The study combines structured knowledge extraction, executable appraisal planning, iterative evidence-grounded generation, and LLM-based evaluation metrics. It evaluates the workflow on historical reports and evidence documents, comparing standard RAG with the proposed approach using conclusion support and hallucination rates.
details.zh: 该研究结合了结构化知识提取、可执行的评价规划、迭代式证据支撑生成以及基于LLM的评价指标。研究使用历史报告和证据文档对该工作流进行评估，并通过结论支持率和幻觉率，将标准RAG与所提出的方法进行比较。

papers.title: Toward Planetary-Scale Intelligence: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Domain Environmental Anomaly Detection and Reasoning
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A supervisor coordinates perception, geospatial, temporal and domain agents—including hydrology—to detect cross-domain environmental anomalies such as flash floods.
summary.zh: 一个监督器协调感知、地理空间、时间和领域智能体（包括水文学智能体），以检测跨领域环境异常，例如山洪。

details.en: The Planetary Intelligence System is a multi-agent architecture in which a supervisor routes work among perception, geospatial, temporal-pattern and environmental-domain agents over typed messages, tiered memory and a retrieval-augmented knowledge layer. The paper reports evaluation on four simulated and two real-world-derived datasets across flash-flood, wildfire, air-quality and seismic-anomaly families, with higher F1, lower latency and fewer false positives than stated single-agent and multi-agent baselines. It is relevant as cross-domain hydrology-adjacent Agent evidence rather than a dedicated operational flood system.
details.zh: Planetary Intelligence System 是一种多智能体架构，监督器通过类型化消息、分层记忆和检索增强知识层，在感知、地理空间、时间模式和环境领域智能体之间分配工作。论文报告了在四个模拟数据集和两个源自真实世界的数据集上的评估，涵盖山洪、野火、空气质量和地震异常类别；与所述的单智能体和多智能体基线相比，其 F1 更高、延迟更低且误报更少。它作为跨领域、与水文学相邻的 Agent 证据具有相关性，而不是一个专用的业务化洪水系统。

limitations.en: The study is limited by higher operational complexity and per-episode cost than single-agent systems, the need for domain-specific tuning of consensus thresholds and routing weights, and substantial reliance on simulated data, with real-world sensor failures and adversarial data only partially represented.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于其运营复杂度和单次处理成本高于单智能体系统，共识阈值与路由权重需要针对具体领域调校，并且在很大程度上依赖模拟数据，对真实传感器故障和对抗性数据的呈现仍不充分。

papers.title: HazardReasoner: Evidence-Grounded Large Language Model Reasoning for Natural-Disaster Inference
papers.venue: 2026 11th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science (ICETIS)

summary.en: HazardReasoner combines evidence ledgers, typed geospatial tools, guideline retrieval and an independent critic for auditable disaster reasoning, including flood-response feasibility.
summary.zh: HazardReasoner结合证据账本、类型化地理空间工具、指南检索和独立批评器，实现可审计的灾害推理，包括洪水响应可行性。

details.en: The framework normalizes public disaster observations into evidence ledgers, compares competing hazard hypotheses, executes typed GIS and numerical tools, retrieves response guidelines, and checks answers with an independent safety critic. The paper reports PubDis-Reason with 1,250 cases and 5,000 questions from DisasterQA, HumAID, CrisisMMD and xBD. Reported macro-F1 is 78.2 versus 72.4 for ReAct, with unsafe-action rate 3.6% versus 7.9%. A flood case rejects a shelter within the projected inundation zone. Results are aggregate multi-hazard metrics, not flood-only performance.
details.zh: 该框架将公共灾害观测规范化为证据账本，比较相互竞争的灾害假设，执行类型化 GIS 和数值工具，检索响应指南，并通过独立安全批评器检查答案。论文报告了包含 1,250 个案例的 PubDis-Reason，以及来自 DisasterQA、HumAID、CrisisMMD 和 xBD 的 5,000 个问题。报告的宏平均 F1 为 78.2，而 ReAct 为 72.4；不安全行动率分别为 3.6% 和 7.9%。一个洪水案例拒绝了位于预测淹没区内的避难所。结果是多灾种指标的汇总，而非仅针对洪水的性能。

papers.title: A human-verified database of reported socioeconomic drought impacts for 368 prefecture-level units in China, 2010–2025
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A human-verified database of reported socioeconomic drought impacts in China, constructed using web search and a retrieval-augmented LLM followed by manual verification.
summary.zh: 一个经过人工核验的中国已报告社会经济干旱影响数据库，使用网络搜索和检索增强型LLM构建，随后进行人工核验。

details.en: The work compiles 5,888 unit-year records for 368 prefecture-level units from 2010–2025, identifies 2,299 verified drought-impact events, and annotates their socioeconomic manifestation types. Qwen3-Max is used with web search to identify reported impacts and generate traceable evidence statements.
details.zh: 该工作汇编了2010–2025年368个地级单位的5,888条单位-年份记录，识别出2,299起经过核验的干旱影响事件，并标注其社会经济表现类型。使用Qwen3-Max结合网络搜索识别已报告的影响，并生成可追溯的证据陈述。

papers.title: A Global Event-Based Benchmark for Tide and Surge Models Beyond the Tide Gauge

summary.en: Introduces a global event-based benchmark for evaluating coastal sea-level and storm-tide models using news-reported flood events identified with an LLM.
summary.zh: 提出一个全球事件型基准，用于评估海岸海平面和风暴潮模型，该基准使用由LLM识别的新闻报道洪水事件。

details.en: The study constructs a global database of approximately 33,000 coastal flood records over 10 years, using an LLM calibrated with tide-gauge data to identify events. It evaluates GTSM and ECCC storm-tide products and compares event-based detection with conventional gauge-based metrics.
details.zh: 该研究构建了一个全球数据库，包含10年间约33,000条海岸洪水记录，并使用经潮位计数据校准的LLM识别事件。研究评估了GTSM和ECCC风暴潮产品，并比较了基于事件的检测与传统基于潮位计的指标。

limitations.en: The study is limited by news-media and temporal reporting biases, imperfect LLM classification and the need for manual tuning, the pragmatic two-year return-period threshold, uncertain 50-km centroid matching, recall-only evaluation that cannot measure false alarms, omission of short-wave and compound-river processes, record-level rather than unified-event analysis with unresolved event weighting, and evaluation of only two global hindcasts.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限包括新闻媒体覆盖和时间分布偏差、LLM分类不完美且需要人工调参、采用务实的两年重现期阈值、50公里质心匹配存在不确定性、仅评估召回率而无法衡量虚警、未纳入短波和河流复合洪水过程、以记录而非统一事件为分析单位且事件权重尚未解决，以及只评估了两个全球模式再分析产品。

papers.title: Towards autonomous urban drainage modelling: evaluating AI agent architectures for automated SWMM calibration

summary.en: The paper evaluates skill-based, tool-based, and multi-agent LLM architectures for automated urban drainage model calibration using SWMM.
summary.zh: 该论文评估了基于技能、基于工具和多智能体的 LLM 架构，用于使用 SWMM 自动校准城市排水模型。

details.en: A controlled SWMM case study compares three agent organisations for coordinating calibration procedures. The study reports equivalent calibrated-model accuracy but differences in reliability, cost, language-model capability requirements, and token consumption.
details.zh: 一项受控的 SWMM 案例研究比较了三种用于协调校准过程的智能体组织方式。研究报告称，校准模型的准确性相当，但在可靠性、成本、语言模型能力要求和 token 消耗方面存在差异。

limitations.en: The study was limited by its use of a single representative catchment, one predefined SWMM calibration workflow with a fixed task-specific capability set, a lack of comparison with expert-led practice, and integrated architecture configurations whose individual features were not isolated.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于仅使用了一个具有代表性的流域、一个配备固定特定任务能力集的预定义 SWMM 校准工作流，未与专家主导的实践进行比较，且未将各架构配置中的单独特征加以隔离。

papers.title: Intelligent extraction of reservoir dispatching information integrating large language model and structured prompts

summary.en: A structured-prompt large language model method and an operational AI agent extract reservoir-dispatch entities and relationships from heterogeneous regulations to support dispatch professionals.
summary.zh: 一种结构化提示大型语言模型方法和一个运行中的 AI agent 从异构法规中提取水库调度实体和关系，以支持调度专业人员。

details.en: The paper addresses the costly and unstable manual or natural-language-prompt-based extraction of reservoir dispatching rules. It refines extraction labels, encodes them with Backus–Naur Form, guides a large language model to produce structured data, and develops an AI agent for dispatch professionals. The reported entity and relationship extraction F1 scores are both above 80%.
details.zh: 论文针对手动或基于自然语言提示的水库调度规则提取成本高且不稳定的问题。论文细化提取标签，使用 Backus–Naur Form 对其进行编码，引导大型语言模型生成结构化数据，并为调度专业人员开发 AI agent。报告的实体和关系提取 F1 分数均高于 80%。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its currently limited set of labels and by differences in extraction performance across the large language models available in the AI agent.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限性在于当前使用的标签集合有限，且智能体所支持的不同大型语言模型会导致提取性能存在差异。

papers.title: HydroSuite-AI: a web-based LLM environment for hydrological code generation and execution for the hydrosuite open-source ecosystem

summary.en: HydroSuite-AI is a web-based LLM assistant for generating, retrieving, validating, and executing hydrological code across the HydroSuite open-source ecosystem.
summary.zh: HydroSuite-AI 是一个基于 Web 的 LLM 助手，用于在 HydroSuite 开源生态系统中生成、检索、验证和执行水文代码。

details.en: The paper presents a Planner-Worker-Synthesizer system with RAG over hydrological library documentation and client-side execution. It evaluates cross-library hydrological workflows, 60 domain-specific tasks, and workshop deployment, reporting differences in function-retrieval accuracy and latency across LLM backends.
details.zh: 该论文介绍了一个 Planner-Worker-Synthesizer 系统，该系统基于水文库文档使用 RAG，并支持客户端执行。该系统评估了跨库水文工作流、60 个特定领域任务和研讨会部署情况，并报告了不同 LLM 后端在函数检索准确率和延迟方面的差异。

limitations.en: The study acknowledges that HydroSuite-AI is limited by its narrow and potentially outdated documentation/training data, 256-dimensional embeddings, limited control over complex multi-step generation, reduced reliability on advanced workflows, and evaluation confined to documented, expert-phrased tasks and the authors’ three libraries.
limitations.zh: 该研究承认，HydroSuite-AI 受限于范围狭窄且可能过时的文档和训练数据、256维嵌入表示、对复杂多步骤生成的控制有限、在高级工作流中的可靠性较低，以及评估仅限于有文档支持且由专家措辞描述的任务和作者开发的三个库。

papers.title: Automated Evaluation Methods for Open-Ended Question in Hydropower Domain Based on Large Language Models

summary.en: The paper proposes an automated method for evaluating large language models on open-ended questions in the hydropower domain.
summary.zh: 该论文提出了一种用于评估大型语言模型在水电领域开放式问题上表现的自动化方法。

details.en: It addresses the limited domain adaptability, efficiency, and subjectivity of manually evaluating LLMs on hydropower open-ended questions. The available abstract indicates that the proposed automated evaluation method is based on LLMs, although its detailed implementation is truncated.
details.zh: 该方法针对人工评估LLM在水电开放式问题上的表现时存在的领域适应性有限、效率低和主观性强等问题。现有摘要表明，所提出的自动化评估方法基于LLM，但其具体实现细节已被截断。

papers.title: Allocation institutions under a food–energy–water nexus drought

summary.en: Compares curtailment, auction, and quota institutions for allocating drought-limited reservoir water, then tests the institutional ranking with language-model claimants.
summary.zh: 比较了在干旱导致水库水资源受限的情况下，用于分配水资源的限供、拍卖和配额制度，随后使用语言模型索取方检验制度排名。

details.en: The study evaluates food-floor breaches and aggregate welfare under three allocation rules for a reservoir serving food and a high-value mobile claimant. Language-model claimants are used to replicate the institutional comparison across two model families, with a reported replication and reasoning-audit protocol.
details.zh: 该研究评估了服务于粮食生产和高价值移动索取方的水库在三种分配规则下的粮食底线突破情况和总体福利。研究使用语言模型索取方，在两个模型系列中复现制度比较，并报告了复现和推理审计方案。

limitations.en: The study is limited by deterministic Phase 0 paths and small, non-powered language-model samples, tests only one fixed calibration and drought without parameter sweeps, and uses a stylized single-basin model that omits lobbying, side payments, farm migration, and a second basin while representing data-centre relocation as binary exit.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限在于：Phase 0路径是确定性的，语言模型样本量小且未进行统计功效计算，仅检验一种固定校准和干旱情景而未进行参数扫描，并采用删去了游说、利益输送、农场迁移和第二流域且将数据中心迁移表示为二元退出的单流域简化模型。

papers.title: Intelligent Recommendation for Safety Risk Precontrol Knowledge in Mega Hydropower Engineering Construction: A Hybrid Method Driven by Textual Semantics
papers.venue: Journal of Construction Engineering and Management

summary.en: A language-model-driven semantic matching and knowledge recommendation method for proactive safety-risk precontrol in mega hydropower construction.
summary.zh: 一种由语言模型驱动的语义匹配与知识推荐方法，用于特大型水电建设中的主动安全风险事前控制。

details.en: The study combines contrastive sentence embeddings, a general language model, interactive semantic-feature fusion, deep text matching, and knowledge retrieval/inference to recommend relevant safety precontrol knowledge for hydropower construction risk factors. It reports an F1-score of 97.57% for semantic matching and 98.95% average precision for recalling the top 10 knowledge items on the stated dataset.
details.zh: 该研究结合对比句嵌入、通用语言模型、交互式语义特征融合、深度文本匹配以及知识检索/推理，为水电建设风险因素推荐相关的安全事前控制知识。研究报告称，在所述数据集上，语义匹配的F1-score为97.57%，召回排名前10项知识的平均精度为98.95%。

papers.title: Improved Flood Management and Risk Communication Through Large Language Models

summary.en: The paper proposes a multimodal RAG-based flood management framework using a Flood Knowledge Graph and diverse hydrological, meteorological, and social-media inputs. It applies LLMs to flood-related decision support, warning and information sharing, and evacuation route planning.
summary.zh: 该论文提出了一种基于多模态 RAG 的洪水管理框架，使用洪水知识图谱以及多样化的水文、气象和社交媒体输入。该框架将 LLM 应用于洪水相关的决策支持、预警与信息共享，以及疏散路线规划。

details.en: The study addresses flood risk management and communication by integrating LLMs/RAG with a Flood Knowledge Graph. It reports improved reliability for flood decision support and proposes expert validation and security layers for operational uses such as flood-constrained evacuation planning.
details.zh: 该研究通过将 LLMs/RAG 与洪水知识图谱相结合，处理洪水风险管理和沟通问题。研究报告称，洪水决策支持的可靠性有所提高，并针对洪水约束下的疏散规划等运营用途，提出了专家验证和安全层。

limitations.en: The system’s performance depends on the timeliness, quality, granularity, and availability of input data, may decline where data infrastructure is inadequate or outdated, and may require clarification for ambiguous or highly complex queries.
limitations.zh: 该系统的性能依赖于输入数据的及时性、质量、粒度和可用性；在数据基础设施不足或过时的地区可能下降，并且对含糊或高度复杂的查询可能需要进一步澄清。

papers.title: Physics-constrained large language model-assisted optimal scheduling approach for hydro-wind-solar systems considering multi-level backwater effects

summary.en: A physics-constrained LLM-assisted method designs scheduling strategies for cascade hydro-wind-solar systems with multi-level backwater effects.
summary.zh: 一种受物理约束的LLM辅助方法为具有多级回水效应的梯级水风光系统设计调度策略。

details.en: The study combines POA decomposition, deterministic hydraulic and physical evaluation, hard-feasibility screening, and LLM-assisted adaptive strategy design. It evaluates the approach on wet, normal, and dry years and Monte Carlo wind-solar scenarios.
details.zh: 该研究结合了POA分解、确定性水力和物理评估、硬可行性筛选以及LLM辅助的自适应策略设计。该方法在丰水年、平水年和枯水年以及蒙特卡洛风光场景下进行评估。

papers.title: Multi-Source Sensing Sparse-Masked Heterogeneous Graph-Constrained Large Language Model for Cross-Condition Fault Diagnosis of Hydropower Unit Rotating Components

summary.en: A sparse-masked heterogeneous graph framework uses multi-source sensing and a frozen LLM for evidence-constrained cross-condition fault diagnosis of hydropower unit rotating components.
summary.zh: 一种稀疏掩码异构图框架利用多源传感和冻结的LLM，对水电机组旋转部件进行受证据约束的跨工况故障诊断。

details.en: The method encodes multi-source vibration and graph relationships, selects a physics-guided sparse evidence subgraph, organizes signal and degradation evidence into prompts, and uses a frozen large language model for diagnostic reasoning. It is evaluated on rotating-machinery datasets and a multi-unit hydropower dataset.
details.zh: 该方法对多源振动和图关系进行编码，选择物理引导的稀疏证据子图，将信号和退化证据组织成提示，并利用冻结的大语言模型进行诊断推理。该方法在旋转机械数据集和多机组水电数据集上进行了评估。

papers.title: FD-SE-LLM: A Semantic-Enhanced Large Language Model Framework for Fault Diagnosis of Hydropower Carbon Brush Bearings
papers.venue: Journal of Dynamics Monitoring and Diagnostics
