summary.en: FD-SE-LLM is an LLM-based framework for cross-condition fault diagnosis of hydropower carbon brush bearings using semantic processing of industrial vibration signals.
summary.zh: FD-SE-LLM 是一种基于 LLM 的框架，用于利用工业振动信号的语义处理对水电碳刷轴承进行跨工况故障诊断。

details.en: The paper addresses operating-condition drift in hydropower equipment diagnosis. It combines semantic projection of periodic and transient vibration features, fault-specific representation disentanglement, and a time adapter within an LLM framework, and reports evaluation on hydropower and other datasets.
details.zh: 该论文针对水电设备诊断中的运行工况漂移问题。在 LLM 框架内，它结合了周期性和瞬态振动特征的语义投影、面向故障的表征解耦以及时间适配器，并报告了在水电数据集和其他数据集上的评估结果。

limitations.en: The study is limited by laboratory-only fault data, reliance on pseudo-labels whose noise above 30% may reduce performance, use of GPT-2 Medium with a computational–generalization trade-off, the lack of a controlled pretrained-versus-random-backbone comparison, and a TSCC periodicity prior that may fail under extreme speed variations.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于故障数据仅来自实验室环境、依赖伪标签且当噪声超过30%时性能可能下降、采用GPT-2 Medium并存在计算成本与泛化能力的权衡、缺乏预训练骨干与随机初始化骨干的受控对比，以及TSCC周期性先验在极端转速变化下可能失效。

papers.title: Citizen flood imagery enhances urban aftermath monitoring and exposes reporting inequities

summary.en: A two-stage framework uses citizen-generated flood images and a fine-tuned vision-language model to produce spatially explicit information on urban flood aftermath and identify reporting gaps.
summary.zh: 一个两阶段框架利用公民生成的洪水图像和经过微调的视觉语言模型，生成关于城市洪水灾后情况的空间明确化信息，并识别报告缺口。

details.en: The study applies flood-masked geolocation and a fine-tuned vision-language model to social media imagery in San Francisco, comparing the resulting flood-aftermath information with institutional reporting and examining socially uneven visibility.
details.zh: 该研究将洪水掩膜地理定位和经过微调的视觉语言模型应用于旧金山的社交媒体图像，将所得的洪水灾后信息与机构报告进行比较，并考察社会不均衡的可见性。

papers.title: Water Quality Assessment Using Transformer, Quantum Neural Network, XGBoost, and Random Forest Models in an Agentic n8n Workflow with Applications in Maritime Robotics, Education, and Training

summary.en: An agentic n8n workflow combines water-quality prediction models with an LLM diagnosis agent for surface-water assessment and decision support.
summary.zh: 一个代理式 n8n 工作流将水质预测模型与 LLM 诊断代理相结合，用于地表水评估和决策支持。

details.en: The paper uses SETX water-quality data and multiple predictive models to classify safe and unsafe surface-water conditions. An LLM-based diagnosis agent then analyzes the predictions, generates a water-quality assessment and risk classification, summarizes the results, and identifies influential parameters.
details.zh: 该论文使用 SETX 水质数据和多个预测模型，对安全和不安全的地表水状况进行分类。随后，一个基于 LLM 的诊断代理分析预测结果，生成水质评估和风险分类，总结结果，并识别具有影响力的参数。

limitations.en: The study was limited to simulated sensor inputs and prototype workflow evaluation, without live IoT or robotic field deployment or assessment of long-term reliability, latency, scalability, failure recovery, and real-world security, while the primary SETX model remained geographically regional and its broader generalizability was unvalidated.
limitations.zh: 该研究仅限于模拟传感器输入和工作流原型评估，未开展物联网或机器人现场部署，也未评估长期可靠性、延迟、可扩展性、故障恢复及现实环境中的安全性；此外，主要的 SETX 模型具有地域局限性，其更广泛的泛化能力尚未得到验证。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal coupling between physical disaster impacts and social sentiment in urban flood events using large language models
papers.venue: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction

papers.title: Relevance is not enough: A Communication-Oriented Retrieval System for Consequential Scientific Question Answering

summary.en: A communication-oriented RAG system helps residents and community leaders interpret public water-quality findings and decide on actions.
summary.zh: 面向沟通的 RAG 系统帮助居民和社区领导者解读公共水质研究结果并决定采取何种行动。

details.en: The system classifies questions by reasoning type, generates follow-up questions to retrieve missing evidence, distinguishes known from uncertain information, and rewrites scientific details into accessible persona-based language. It is evaluated on more than 160 questions using human-centered completeness measures.
details.zh: 该系统按推理类型对问题进行分类，生成后续问题以检索缺失的证据，区分已知信息与不确定信息，并将科学细节改写为易于理解的基于角色的语言。系统使用以人为中心的完整性指标，在超过 160 个问题上进行评估。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its reliance on proprietary black-box language models, the possibility that other models or domain-specific fine-tuning would yield different results, and the limited cross-domain transferability of its water-quality-specific diagnostic questions.
limitations.zh: 本研究的局限在于依赖专有的黑箱语言模型，其他模型或领域特定微调可能产生不同结果，并且其针对水质设计的诊断问题跨领域迁移能力有限。

papers.title: Where should control sit? Reliability-cost trade-offs in delegating water distribution network optimisation to LLM agents

summary.en: The study evaluates where autonomous LLM agents should control stages of water distribution network optimisation, comparing reliability, resource cost and solution quality across deterministic and ReAct-based workflows.
summary.zh: 该研究评估自主 LLM 代理应在何处控制供水网络优化的各个阶段，比较确定性工作流和基于 ReAct 的工作流在可靠性、资源成本和解决方案质量方面的表现。

details.en: It examines single-objective pump energy minimisation and multi-objective energy-resilience optimisation on the C-Town water distribution network across five LLMs. The study finds that delegating nodes to ReAct agents increases resource use and can cause structural workflow failures, while optimisation quality is relatively insensitive to control allocation.
details.zh: 研究考察了五个 LLM 在 C-Town 供水网络上的单目标泵能耗最小化和多目标能耗—韧性优化。研究发现，将节点委托给 ReAct 代理会增加资源使用，并可能导致工作流结构性故障，而优化质量对控制分配相对不敏感。

papers.title: What structured tool interfaces do and do not provide for LLM-based SWAT+ calibration
Towards Smart Water Infrastructure: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Acoustic Leak Detection

summary.en: A retrieval-augmented LLM framework retrieves historical pipeline acoustic cases and uses them to generate evidence-grounded water-pipeline leak diagnoses and reports.
summary.zh: 一种检索增强的 LLM 框架检索历史管道声学案例，并利用这些案例生成基于证据的供水管道泄漏诊断和报告。

details.en: The study constructs a database of historical acoustic cases from water distribution networks, retrieves relevant cases, and incorporates them into LLM prompts for acoustic leak detection. It evaluates the approach on samples from Dalian and Hong Kong and reports diagnostic performance comparable to specialized supervised models.
details.zh: 该研究从供水网络中构建历史声学案例数据库，检索相关案例，并将其纳入 LLM 提示词中，用于声学泄漏检测。该方法在来自大连和香港的样本上进行了评估，并报告称其诊断性能与专门的监督模型相当。

papers.title: Toward advanced management of sludge bulking: An explainable evaluation framework to quantify and improve large language model cognitive capabilities
Retrieval-Augmented Classification of Environmental Mitigations in Hydropower Licensing Documents

summary.en: A preprint develops BERT, RAG, and hybrid pipelines to classify environmental mitigation obligations in hydropower licensing documents under severe label scarcity.
summary.zh: 一篇预印本开发了 BERT、RAG 和混合式流程，用于在标签严重匮乏的情况下，对水电许可文件中的环境减缓义务进行分类。

details.en: The study evaluates classification over 5,860 paragraphs from 2017 hydropower license documents and 135 mitigation categories. Its RAG pipeline retrieves category definitions to support zero-shot classification, while a hybrid combines BERT detection with RAG classification.
details.zh: 该研究基于来自2017年水电许可证文件的5,860个段落和135个减缓类别评估分类效果。其 RAG 流程检索类别定义以支持零样本分类，而混合式流程将 BERT 检测与 RAG 分类相结合。

limitations.en: The study is limited by structural label scarcity—81 of 135 categories are absent from the 2017 test set—and a BERT-detector false-positive bottleneck, while the evaluated augmentation strategies provided little end-to-end improvement and hard-negative retraining reduced recall.
limitations.zh: 该研究受结构性标签稀缺限制——135个类别中有81个未出现在2017年测试集——并受到BERT检测器误报瓶颈的影响；所评估的数据增强策略对端到端性能提升有限，而困难负样本再训练降低了召回率。

papers.title: Large language model as reservoir operator: a generative agent bridging human judgment and optimization in water resource systems

summary.en: The paper evaluates an LLM as a reservoir operator for monthly water-supply allocation at Folsom Lake over a 21-year simulation.
summary.zh: 该论文评估了LLM作为水库调度员，在Folsom Lake进行为期21年的月度供水分配模拟中的表现。

details.en: An LLM makes reservoir release and water-supply allocation decisions from contextual information. Its behavior and performance are benchmarked against historical operations, a neural-network regressor, and dynamic programming, with analyses of chain-of-thought outputs, sensitivity, and rationale.
details.zh: LLM根据情境信息做出水库放流和供水分配决策。其行为和性能与历史运行结果、神经网络回归器和动态规划进行基准比较，并分析了思维链输出、敏感性和决策依据。

papers.title: Grounding large language models in hydrologic modelling

summary.en: HydroAIM grounds LLM agents in automated hydrological time-series modelling using expert workflows, an MCP architecture and execution feedback.
summary.zh: HydroAIM 通过专家工作流、MCP 架构和执行反馈，将 LLM agents 应用于自动化水文时间序列建模。

details.en: The framework combines expert task planning, a standardised algorithmic workflow library and an iterative execution toolbox. The paper reports 92.8% execution success across 125 tasks using five LLMs; removing the expert workflow reduces success to 0%. Across 531 CAMELS catchments, reported median NSE is 0.58 for local models and 0.73 for global models. This is a hydrological modelling study, distinct from the hydropower operation chapter.
details.zh: 该框架结合了专家任务规划、标准化算法工作流库和迭代式执行工具箱。论文报告称，使用五个 LLM 在 125 项任务中的执行成功率为 92.8%；移除专家工作流后，成功率降至 0%。在 531 个 CAMELS 流域中，报告的局部模型中位数 NSE 为 0.58，全局模型中位数 NSE 为 0.73。这是一项水文建模研究，与水电运行章节不同。

papers.title: Event logic graph-augmented generation for interpretable urban waterlogging emergency decision-making

summary.en: The paper proposes ELGAG, a graph-augmented RAG framework that retrieves causal waterlogging evidence and uses an LLM to generate interpretable emergency assessment reports.
summary.zh: 该论文提出了 ELGAG，一种图增强 RAG 框架，用于检索因果性内涝证据，并利用 LLM 生成可解释的应急评估报告。

details.en: It organizes historical urban waterlogging cases, causal factors, response actions, responsible entities, and emergency resources into an Event Logic Graph. Retrieved cause–event–response evidence is supplied under domain-enhanced prompt constraints to an LLM for emergency report generation, with validation-gated feedback for knowledge evolution. Experiments use Guangzhou urban waterlogging data from 2010–2019 and compare the framework with vector-based and graph-enhanced RAG baselines.
details.zh: 该框架将历史城市内涝案例、因果因素、响应行动、负责实体和应急资源组织成 Event Logic Graph。在领域增强的提示约束下，将检索到的原因–事件–响应证据提供给 LLM 以生成应急报告，并通过验证门控反馈实现知识演化。实验使用 2010–2019 年的 Guangzhou 城市内涝数据，并将该框架与基于向量和图增强的 RAG 基线进行比较。

papers.title: Enhancing LLM-based generation of safety hazard rectification measures for mega hydropower construction via cascaded RAG and adaptive ColBERT
An interpretable river water quality prediction model by integrating deep learning and large language models
papers.venue: DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals)

summary.en: An interpretable urban river water-quality prediction workflow combines a TCN-Attention model, SHAP analysis, and Qwen3-Next-generated grading and improvement recommendations.
summary.zh: 一种可解释的城市河流水质预测工作流结合了TCN-Attention模型、SHAP分析以及由Qwen3-Next生成的分级和改进建议。

details.en: The study predicts six river water-quality indicators using a TCN-Attention deep-learning model with Bayesian optimization and SHAP interpretation. Qwen3-Next generates water-quality grade evaluations and targeted improvement recommendations for rivers in Xinwu District, Wuxi City.
details.zh: 该研究使用结合贝叶斯优化和SHAP解释的TCN-Attention深度学习模型预测六项河流水质指标。Qwen3-Next为无锡市新吴区的河流生成水质等级评估和针对性的改进建议。

papers.title: Actionable Hydrologic Data to Information with National Water Model-Based Derived Dataset, Cutting-Edge Data Services, and Agentic AI System

summary.en: Develops a National Water Model-derived streamflow dataset, enhanced data services, and a multi-agent LLM system for automated hydrologic information generation.
summary.zh: 开发了一个源自 National Water Model 的流量数据集、增强型数据服务以及一个用于自动生成水文信息的多智能体 LLM 系统。

details.en: The study computes streamflow indices for National Water Model reaches, enhances an API with geospatial and metadata functions, develops an MCP server for LLM applications, and builds a multi-agent LLM system that leverages NWM and other hydrologic data to streamline hydrologic data-to-information workflows.
details.zh: 该研究为 National Water Model 河段计算流量指数，通过地理空间和元数据功能增强 API，开发用于 LLM 应用的 MCP 服务器，并构建一个利用 NWM 及其他水文数据的多智能体 LLM 系统，以简化水文数据到信息的工作流程。

papers.title: AI-enabled root-cause diagnosis of water quality anomalies in continuous monitoring networks using a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach

summary.en: WQ-RAG uses Llama-3-8B and retrieved regulatory documents to diagnose water-quality anomalies detected by deep-learning models.
summary.zh: WQ-RAG 使用 Llama-3-8B 和检索到的监管文件，诊断深度学习模型检测到的水质异常。

details.en: The study evaluates four USGS river monitoring stations using 2021–2024 data. A knowledge base of 25 regulatory and technical documents grounds Llama-3-8B explanations. Reported mean explanation quality is 0.840 ± 0.071; retrieval improves regulatory accuracy from 0.20 to 0.76. The LLM performs regulation-aware root-cause diagnosis and recommendations, while deep-learning models perform anomaly detection.
details.zh: 该研究使用 2021–2024 年的数据评估了 4 个 USGS 河流监测站点。由 25 份监管和技术文件构成的知识库为 Llama-3-8B 的解释提供依据。报告的平均解释质量为 0.840 ± 0.071；检索使监管准确率从 0.20 提高到 0.76。LLM 执行结合监管要求的根因诊断和建议，而深度学习模型执行异常检测。

papers.title: A football optimization–enhanced deep learning framework with large language model guidance for desalination systems

summary.en: A desalination-system performance prediction framework combines LLM-guided preprocessing and feature selection with Football Optimization Algorithm tuning of deep learning models.
summary.zh: 一种脱盐系统性能预测框架将 LLM 引导的预处理和特征选择与 Football Optimization Algorithm 对深度学习模型的调优相结合。

details.en: The paper evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs for preprocessing and feature selection in a desalination dataset, then uses the Football Optimization Algorithm to optimize deep learning models, particularly STGCNs, for desalination performance prediction. Experiments use synthetic data and report improved predictive metrics and reduced feature subsets.
details.zh: 该论文评估了最先进的 LLM 在脱盐数据集预处理和特征选择中的表现，然后使用 Football Optimization Algorithm 优化深度学习模型，尤其是 STGCNs，以进行脱盐性能预测。实验使用合成数据，并报告了改进的预测指标和缩减后的特征子集。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its synthetic, relatively homogeneous data, the sensitivity of hyperparameter optimization to search settings and computational budget, and the absence of a separate conventional rule-based preprocessing baseline.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于所用数据为合成且相对单一的数据，超参数优化对搜索设置和计算预算较为敏感，并且缺少独立的传统基于规则的预处理基线。

papers.title: WADE: A Reasoning-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Instance Floating-Waste Grounding with Compact Vision-Language Models

summary.en: WADE is a reasoning-annotated benchmark for compact VLMs that detect, classify, count, and explain floating waste in inland waterways.
summary.zh: WADE 是一个带有推理标注的基准数据集，用于让紧凑型 VLMs 检测、分类、计数并解释内陆水道中的漂浮垃圾。

details.en: The preprint introduces 2,167 images from rural Bangladesh with 13,608 bounding boxes across ten floating-waste categories. It evaluates six VLMs under zero-shot, few-shot, reasoning-guided, and fine-tuned settings, including Qwen3-VL-2B adaptation with QLoRA.
details.zh: 该预印本介绍了来自孟加拉国农村的 2,167 张图像，其中包含覆盖十个漂浮垃圾类别的 13,608 个边界框。它在零样本、少样本、推理引导和微调设置下评估了六个 VLMs，包括使用 QLoRA 对 Qwen3-VL-2B 进行适配。

limitations.en: The study is limited by the absence of box-and-label-only ablations and specialized-detector baselines, data collected only in rural Bangladesh, category-level rather than instance-specific reasoning chains, no formal inter-annotator agreement measure, potential evaluator bias, and possible changes to commercial APIs.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限包括缺少仅使用框和标签的消融实验及专用检测器基线、数据仅采集于孟加拉国农村地区、推理链仅为类别级而非实例级、未报告正式的标注者间一致性指标、评估者可能存在偏差，以及商业 API 可能发生变化。

papers.title: Verifiable abstention makes AI leak diagnosis accountable in urban water distribution networks

summary.en: A physics-grounded leak-diagnosis workflow uses an independent LLM auditor to support accountable abstention and reject insufficiently supported excavation recommendations.
summary.zh: 一种以物理学为基础的漏损诊断工作流使用独立的 LLM 审计器，以支持可问责的弃权，并拒绝证据支持不足的开挖建议。

details.en: The study evaluates selective leak localization in urban water distribution networks using a hydraulic twin, deterministic checks, and an LLM auditor that can add rejections but cannot override failed checks.
details.zh: 该研究使用液压孪生体、确定性检查和 LLM 审计器，评估城市供水管网中的选择性漏损定位；该审计器可以增加拒绝结果，但不能推翻未通过的检查。

limitations.en: The study is limited by literature-prior confounder classes, only four accepted events in its strongest external L-Town test, no head-to-head comparison with a published state-of-the-art localizer, possible conformal-exchangeability failure under sim-to-real shift, small active-sensing gains at the tested sensor density, an LLM executor that adds interpretability rather than accuracy, an auditor that only partly generalizes beyond enumerated rules, and City D analyses relying on a 2016-vintage model with proxy demand updating, an unknown coordinate datum, proxy work-order windows, and twin-sim
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限包括：混淆因素类别依据文献先验构建，最强外部 L-Town 测试仅接受了 4 个事件，未与已发表的最先进定位器进行正面对比，在仿真到真实的分布偏移下交换性假设可能失效，在所测传感器密度下主动感知收益较小，LLM 执行器提升的是可解释性而非准确性，审计器对枚举规则之外情况的泛化仅部分成立，以及 City D 分析依赖 2016 年版本模型、代理性需求更新、未知坐标基准、作为代理的工单时间窗和孪生模拟而非真实 SCADA 的压力与流量。

papers.title: AquaAgent-OSPy: an auditable LLM tool-agent system for simulation-grounded irrigation decision support
WaterAdmin: Orchestrating Community Water Distribution Optimization via AI Agents

details.en: We study the operation of community water systems, where pumps and valves must be scheduled to reliably meet water demands while minimizing energy consumption. While existing optimization-based methods are effective under well-modeled environments, real-world community scenarios exhibit highly dynamic contexts-such as human activities, weather variations, etc-that significantly affect water demand patterns and operational targets across different zones. Traditional optimization approaches struggle to aggregate and adapt to such heterogeneous and rapidly evolving contextual information in real time. Evidence limitation: Title/abstract screening; report excerpt used where the API has no abstract.
details.zh: 我们研究社区供水系统的运行，其中泵和阀门必须进行调度，以可靠地满足用水需求，同时最大限度地降低能耗。现有的基于优化的方法在建模良好的环境下表现有效，但现实世界的社区场景呈现出高度动态的情境——例如人类活动、天气变化等——这些情境会显著影响不同区域的用水需求模式和运行目标。传统的优化方法难以在实时聚合此类异质且快速演变的情境信息并据此进行适应。证据局限性：标题/摘要筛选；在 API 没有摘要的情况下使用报告摘录。

limitations.en: The study discretizes water demand into only five levels, which may limit the extent to which larger LLMs can be exploited for more precise demand prediction.
limitations.zh: 该研究将用水需求离散为仅五个等级，这可能限制大型语言模型在更精确需求预测方面的能力发挥。

papers.title: Simulator-Grounded Large Language Models for Industrial Causal Reasoning: Tool-Use, Structured Injection, and Plant-Portable Retrieval for Wastewater Treatment Decision Support

details.en: Wastewater operators need answers grounded in how their plant's variables interact and how fast effects propagate, not in generic pretraining text, when asking causal questions such as "why is N2O rising?" or "what happens if I cut aeration by 20%?". We compare three concrete ways to ground a frozen Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct model in an architecturally interpretable wastewater simulator (CCSS-IX): a live simulator oracle (Method 1), structured parameter injection (Method 2), and a Decoupled Recall-Reasoning (DRR) retriever (Method 3). On a 198-question causal benchmark the three reach 99.5%, 79%, and 75.8%, forming a deployment ladder above the strongest retrieval-augmented baseline at 48%. Evidence limitation: Title/abstract screening; report excerpt used where the API has no abstract.
details.zh: 当询问“为什么 N2O 在上升？”或“如果我将曝气量削减 20%，会发生什么？”等因果问题时，污水处理厂操作人员需要的是基于其工厂变量如何相互作用以及影响传播速度的答案，而不是通用预训练文本。我们比较了将冻结的 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 模型建立在架构可解释的污水处理模拟器（CCSS-IX）基础上的三种具体方法：实时模拟器预言器（方法 1）、结构化参数注入（方法 2）以及解耦式回忆-推理（DRR）检索器（方法 3）。在包含 198 个问题的因果基准测试中，三种方法分别达到 99.5%、79% 和 75.8%，形成了一条部署阶梯，优于最强的检索增强基线（48%）。证据限制：进行了标题/摘要筛选；在 API 没有摘要的情况下使用报告摘录。

limitations.en: The study is quantitatively validated mainly on two wastewater-treatment plants, while Method 1 depends on a live simulator, Method 3 requires calibration data, the deterministic scorer can penalize correct paraphrases, and Method 1’s latency limits high-frequency closed-loop control.
limitations.zh: 该研究的定量验证主要限于两座污水处理厂；此外，方法1依赖实时模拟器，方法3需要校准数据，确定性评分器可能误判正确的释义表达，而方法1的延迟限制了其用于高频闭环控制。

papers.title: Making Waves: Emerging Risks as Regulatory Mismatch Meets Automation in LLM-Agents like OpenClaw for Water Treatment and Environmental Infrastructure
D2: An LLM agent driving end-to-end visual AI modeling in energy platforms

summary.en: D2 is an LLM modeling agent evaluated on hydropower inflow forecasting.
summary.zh: D2 是一个经过水电入流预测评估的 LLM 建模智能体。

details.en: The X-AI platform uses the D2 LLM agent for model construction and workflow optimization, with a hydropower inflow forecasting case.
details.zh: X-AI 平台使用 D2 LLM 智能体进行模型构建和工作流优化，并采用水电入流预测案例。

papers.title: Construction Safety Knowledge Reasoning-Capable Large Language Model for Hydropower and Water Conservancy Engineering
papers.venue: Journal of Construction Engineering and Management

papers.title: AI-Driven Reinvention of Hydrological Modeling for Accurate Predictions and Interpretation to Transform Earth System Modeling

details.en: Traditional equation-driven hydrological models often struggle to accurately predict streamflow in challenging regional Earth systems like the Tibetan Plateau, while hybrid and existing algorithm-driven models face difficulties in interpreting hydrological behaviors. This work introduces HydroTrace, an algorithm-driven, data-agnostic model that substantially outperforms these approaches, achieving a Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency of 98% and demonstrating strong generalization on unseen data. Moreover, HydroTrace leverages advanced attention mechanisms to capture spatial-temporal variations and feature-specific impacts, enabling the quantification and spatial resolution of streamflow partitioning as well as the interpretation of hydrological behaviors such as glacier-snow-streamflow interactions and monsoon dynamics. Evidence limitation: Title/abstract screening; report excerpt used where the API has no abstract.
details.zh: 传统的方程驱动水文模型通常难以准确预测青藏高原等具有挑战性的区域地球系统中的河川流量，而混合模型和现有的算法驱动模型在解释水文行为方面也面临困难。本研究提出了HydroTrace，这是一种算法驱动、与数据无关的模型，其性能显著优于这些方法，实现了98%的Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency，并在未见数据上展现出很强的泛化能力。此外，HydroTrace利用先进的注意力机制捕捉时空变化和特征特异性影响，从而实现对河川流量分配的量化与空间分辨，以及对冰川-积雪-河川流量相互作用和季风动力学等水文行为的解释。证据限制：标题/摘要筛选；在API没有摘要的情况下使用报告摘录。

limitations.en: HydroTrace relies on high-quality gridded land-surface data that may be unavailable in some regions, and its complex attention mechanisms may be difficult for non-experts to interpret.
limitations.zh: HydroTrace依赖高质量的网格化地表数据，而这些数据在某些地区可能无法获得；此外，其复杂的注意力机制可能难以被非专业人士理解。

papers.title: A Method for Parsing and Vectorization of Semi-structured Data used in Retrieval Augmented Generation

details.en: This paper presents a novel method for parsing and vectorizing semi-structured data to enhance the functionality of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) within Large Language Models (LLMs). We developed a comprehensive pipeline for converting various data formats into .docx, enabling efficient parsing and structured data extraction. The core of our methodology involves the construction of a vector database using Pinecone, which integrates seamlessly with LLMs to provide accurate, context-specific responses, particularly in environmental management and wastewater treatment operations. Evidence limitation: Title/abstract screening; report excerpt used where the API has no abstract.
details.zh: 本文提出了一种用于解析和向量化半结构化数据的新方法，以增强大型语言模型（LLMs）中检索增强生成（RAG）的功能。我们开发了一套完整的流程，用于将各种数据格式转换为 .docx，从而实现高效解析和结构化数据提取。我们方法的核心是使用 Pinecone 构建向量数据库，该数据库可与 LLMs 无缝集成，以提供准确且特定于上下文的响应，尤其适用于环境管理和废水处理运营。证据局限性：标题/摘要筛选；在 API 没有摘要的情况下使用报告摘录。

limitations.en: The study is limited by the model’s insufficient support for Chinese elements in images, requiring additional captions or related information to improve recognition accuracy.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于模型对图像中中文元素的支持不足，需要额外的图注或相关信息来提高识别准确性。

papers.title: A Generative AI-Driven Reliability Layer for Action-Oriented Disaster Resilience

details.en: As climate-related hazards intensify, conventional early warning systems (EWS) disseminate alerts rapidly but often fail to trigger timely protective actions, leading to preventable losses and inequities. We introduce Climate RADAR (Risk-Aware, Dynamic, and Action Recommendation system), a generative AI-based reliability layer that reframes disaster communication from alerts delivered to actions executed. It integrates meteorological, hydrological, vulnerability, and social data into a composite risk index and employs guardrail-embedded large language models (LLMs) to deliver personalized recommendations across citizen, volunteer, and municipal interfaces. Evidence limitation: Title/abstract screening; report excerpt used where the API has no abstract.
details.zh: 随着气候相关灾害加剧，传统的预警系统（EWS）能够快速传播警报，但往往无法促使人们及时采取防护行动，从而导致本可避免的损失和不平等。我们提出 Climate RADAR（Risk-Aware, Dynamic, and Action Recommendation system），一种基于生成式 AI 的可靠性层，将灾害通信从传递警报重新定义为执行行动。该系统将气象、水文、脆弱性和社会数据整合为综合风险指数，并采用嵌入防护机制的大型语言模型（LLMs），通过面向公民、志愿者和市政部门的界面提供个性化建议。证据局限性：进行了标题/摘要筛选；在 API 没有摘要的情况下使用报告摘录。

limitations.en: The study’s evaluation was limited to flash-flood and heatwave scenarios within a single municipal jurisdiction, did not implement algorithmic debiasing despite identifying subgroup disparities, and captured only short-term trust dynamics.
limitations.zh: 该研究的评估仅限于单一市辖区内的山洪和极端热浪情景，尽管发现了群体差异但尚未实施算法去偏方法，且仅考察了短期信任动态。

papers.title: Large language models for sustainable water management: A review
On-device artificial intelligence agent based on language models for electrochemical water desalination

summary.en: An edge-deployed language-model agent combines electrochemical process knowledge, retrieval, and predictive models for decentralized desalination support without cloud connectivity.
summary.zh: 一种边缘部署的语言模型智能体结合电化学过程知识、检索和预测模型，在无需云连接的情况下为去中心化海水淡化提供支持。

details.en: The study deploys a language-model-based assistant on devices such as Raspberry Pi for electrochemical water desalination, combining process knowledge, retrieval, and predictive components for real-time optimization under limited computing and incomplete sensor data. Evaluation against 320 published studies reports a 60% reduction in hallucination rates and R² above 0.80 for effluent concentration and energy predictions, while applied-current prediction accuracy rises from 0.03 to 0.63. The result is notable because it tests a domain-grounded water-treatment agent under edge-computing and data-imperfect conditions.
details.zh: 该研究将基于语言模型的助手部署在 Raspberry Pi 等设备上，用于电化学水淡化，并结合过程知识、检索和预测组件，在计算能力有限且传感器数据不完整的情况下进行实时优化。与 320 项已发表研究的评估表明，幻觉率降低了 60%，出水浓度和能耗预测的 R² 高于 0.80，而施加电流预测准确率从 0.03 提高到 0.63。该结果值得关注，因为它在边缘计算和数据不完善的条件下测试了一个基于领域知识的水处理智能体。

papers.title: Natural language-driven water quality inversion using LLMs and cloud platforms

summary.en: The study turns natural-language requests into Google Earth Engine water-quality inversion workflows using domain-specific RAG, executable code generation, visualization, and result summaries.
summary.zh: 该研究利用领域特定的RAG、可执行代码生成、可视化和结果摘要，将自然语言请求转化为Google Earth Engine水质反演工作流。

details.en: The framework integrates LLMs, a water-quality knowledge base, and Google Earth Engine to automate data screening, spatiotemporal constraint interpretation, inversion-model selection, code execution, visualization, and result explanation. Reported evaluation includes 0.92 task-parsing consistency, 94% spatial matching, 93% temporal matching, and an 87% executable-code rate for the RAG-enhanced Qwen2.5-Coder configuration. It therefore provides task-specific evidence that language-model orchestration can reduce the technical burden of remote-sensing water-quality monitoring.
details.zh: 该框架集成LLM、水质知识库和Google Earth Engine，以自动完成数据筛选、时空约束解释、反演模型选择、代码执行、可视化和结果说明。报告的评估结果包括任务解析一致性为0.92、空间匹配率为94%、时间匹配率为93%，以及RAG增强的Qwen2.5-Coder配置的可执行代码率为87%。因此，该框架提供了针对特定任务的证据，表明语言模型编排可以降低遥感水质监测的技术负担。

papers.title: Hydrology Copilot: A cloud-native AI system for hydrological data analysis

summary.en: Hydrology Copilot coordinates LLM agents, cloud-native NLDAS-3 access, inspectable code, memory, and validation for reproducible drought-analysis workflows.
summary.zh: Hydrology Copilot 协调 LLM 代理、云原生 NLDAS-3 访问、可检查代码、记忆和验证，以实现可复现的干旱分析工作流。

details.en: Hydrology Copilot translates natural-language requests into hydrological analyses over NASA NLDAS-3 data using a multi-agent architecture for query parsing, code generation, execution, and visualization. Its design adds persistent memory, dataset-aware query validation, inspectable Python workflows, Kerchunk-based data virtualization, and expert-validated hydrological functions. Benchmark analyses match expert reference results, drought diagnostics agree with the operational U.S. Drought Monitor, and data-access optimizations improve I/O latency by 1.5–4.6 times, providing unusually concrete evidence for a deployable hydrological copilot.
details.zh: Hydrology Copilot 使用多代理架构，将自然语言请求转换为基于 NASA NLDAS-3 数据的水文分析，用于查询解析、代码生成、执行和可视化。其设计增加了持久化记忆、数据集感知的查询验证、可检查的 Python 工作流、基于 Kerchunk 的数据虚拟化以及经专家验证的水文函数。基准分析结果与专家参考结果一致，干旱诊断结果与运营中的 U.S. Drought Monitor 一致，并且数据访问优化将 I/O 延迟提升了 1.5–4.6 倍，为可部署的水文副驾驶提供了异常具体的证据。

papers.title: HydroSuite-AI: Facilitating Hydrological Research with LLM-Driven Code Assistance

summary.en: HydroSuite-AI connects an LLM interface to HydroLang, HydroCompute, and HydroRTC for hydrological code generation, execution, and library-specific question answering.
summary.zh: HydroSuite-AI 将 LLM 接口连接到 HydroLang、HydroCompute 和 HydroRTC，用于水文代码生成、执行以及特定于库的问题回答。

details.en: HydroSuite-AI is an LLM-enhanced web application intended to reduce the coding and documentation burden in hydrological analysis. It integrates three open-source hydrology libraries, generates code snippets, provides an execution environment, and answers factual questions about the supported tools so that users can move from natural-language requests to executable analysis. Case studies and user feedback provide early evidence for hydrological research and education use.
details.zh: HydroSuite-AI 是一款由 LLM 增强的 Web 应用，旨在减轻水文分析中的编码和文档负担。它集成了三个开源水文学库，生成代码片段，提供执行环境，并回答有关所支持工具的事实性问题，使用户能够从自然语言请求转向可执行分析。案例研究和用户反馈为其在水文研究和教育中的应用提供了初步证据。

papers.title: Human-AI teaming for water quality documentation analysis with large language models

summary.en: The EWRA study compares three OpenAI models with human reviewers on 20 water-quality documents and finds that localized chunking improves coding accuracy and agreement.
summary.zh: EWRA 研究比较了三个 OpenAI 模型与人工审阅者在 20 份水质文件上的表现，发现局部化分块提高了编码准确率和一致性。

details.en: The two-page EWRA 2025 paper evaluates GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, and o1-mini as additional reviewers of urban water-quality documentation. Twenty laboratory and field documents were manually coded for concerns including corrosion, pollutants, and chemical imbalances, then processed through open and localized chunk-based prompting and assessed using agreement, accuracy, precision, recall, and Fleiss' Kappa. The reported results show that utility-specific definitions and localized context improve accuracy, cross-run agreement, and true-positive identification, supporting a bounded human-LLM workflow for documentation review.
details.zh: 这篇两页的 EWRA 2025 论文评估了 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini 和 o1-mini 作为城市水质文档的额外审阅者。20 份实验室和现场文件被人工编码，以识别腐蚀、污染物和化学失衡等问题，随后通过开放式和局部化的基于分块的提示进行处理，并使用一致性、准确率、精确率、召回率和 Fleiss' Kappa 进行评估。报告结果显示，针对公用事业的特定定义和局部化上下文提高了准确率、跨运行一致性和真阳性识别能力，支持采用受限的人类-LLM 文档审查工作流。

papers.title: Evaluating the logical and mathematical reasoning capabilities of language models in agricultural water management

summary.en: DEW and FLOW benchmark how large reasoning models handle 419 logical and mathematical agricultural water-management questions and how graph-RAG changes their performance.
summary.zh: DEW 和 FLOW 对大型推理模型处理 419 个农业水资源管理逻辑和数学问题的能力，以及图 RAG 如何改变其表现进行了基准测试。

details.en: The article introduces the 419-question Dataset for Evaluating Water Management across 24 agricultural water-management domains and a graph retrieval-augmented prompting framework called FLOW. It evaluates o3-medium, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Qwen3-30B-A3B, reporting average gains over chain-of-thought prompting of 7.73% for logical reasoning and 16.33% for mathematical reasoning. The benchmark also identifies economic decisions, empirical equations, and model overconfidence as important weaknesses, making it useful evidence about the foundational reasoning capabilities on which later water-management agents would depend.
details.zh: 该文章介绍了跨越 24 个农业水资源管理领域的 419 题水资源管理评估数据集，以及一种名为 FLOW 的图检索增强提示框架。文章评估了 o3-medium、Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B，并报告称，与思维链提示相比，逻辑推理和数学推理的平均提升分别为 7.73% 和 16.33%。该基准测试还确定经济决策、经验方程和模型过度自信是重要弱点，为后续水资源管理智能体所依赖的基础推理能力提供了有用证据。

papers.title: A conversational intelligent assistant for enhanced operational support in floodplain management with multimodal data

summary.en: Floodplain Manager AI combines LLM-based semantic search with multimodal FEMA flood-map interpretation to provide location-specific regulatory guidance for floodplain management.
summary.zh: Floodplain Manager AI 将基于 LLM 的语义搜索与 FEMA 洪水地图的多模态解读相结合，为洪泛区管理提供特定位置的监管指导。

details.en: The study develops Floodplain Manager AI as a decision-support assistant for floodplain managers who must interpret regulations, retrieve location-specific information, and communicate flood risk. It combines large language models, semantic search, and multimodal interpretation of FEMA flood maps, and reports experimental improvements in response accuracy and relevance. The work is directly relevant to flood-risk operations because the language model is grounded in regulatory and geospatial materials rather than used only for generic question answering.
details.zh: 该研究开发了 Floodplain Manager AI，作为洪泛区管理人员的决策支持助手，帮助他们解读法规、检索特定位置的信息并传达洪水风险。它结合了大型语言模型、语义搜索以及对 FEMA 洪水地图的多模态解读，并报告了响应准确性和相关性的实验改进。由于该语言模型基于监管和地理空间材料，而不是仅用于通用问答，因此这项工作与洪水风险运营直接相关。

limitations.en: The study’s evaluation covered only specific aspects of system performance, used curated data that may not include all relevant information, and did not test a broader range of scenarios or a more diverse user base, while rapid AI advances may reduce the findings’ continuing relevance.
limitations.zh: 该研究的评估仅涵盖系统性能的特定方面，所用精选数据可能未包含全部相关信息，也未在更广泛的场景和更多样化的用户群体中进行测试；此外，人工智能的快速发展可能降低研究结果持续适用的相关性。

papers.title: Integrating LLM-based agents with uncertainty-aware optimization for water-energy-carbon nexus management in irrigation districts
FloodReasonBench: Benchmarking VLM Reasoning Segmentation for Embodied Flood Response at the Edge

summary.en: FloodReasonBench introduces a flood-specific VLM reasoning-segmentation dataset and jointly measures segmentation quality, latency, energy, and communication cost on an NVIDIA Jetson edge platform.
summary.zh: FloodReasonBench提出了一个专用于洪水的VLM推理-分割数据集，并在NVIDIA Jetson边缘平台上联合测量分割质量、延迟、能耗和通信成本。

details.en: FloodReasonBench evaluates how VLMs translate response-oriented language requests into pixel-level grounding for people, buildings, vehicles, and other targets in real flood scenes. Its FloodResponseSeg dataset supports a benchmark that combines task accuracy with lightweight visual encoding, hierarchical split inference, compressed intermediate representations, and measurements on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier. The results expose operating trade-offs among flood-scene segmentation quality, edge latency, energy consumption, and communication footprint for resource-constrained embodied response platforms.
details.zh: FloodReasonBench评估VLM如何将面向响应的语言请求转化为真实洪水场景中人员、建筑物、车辆及其他目标的像素级定位。其FloodResponseSeg数据集支持一项基准测试，将任务准确率与轻量级视觉编码、分层拆分推理、压缩中间表示以及在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上的测量相结合。结果揭示了资源受限的具身响应平台在洪水场景分割质量、边缘延迟、能耗和通信开销之间的运行权衡。

papers.title: Can large language models quantify urban floods from multi-source textual information

summary.en: DeepFlood uses LLM reference-based inference to estimate flash-flood depth categories from event narratives, reaching 95.5% category accuracy against expert estimates in the Greater New York case.
summary.zh: DeepFlood 使用基于 LLM 参考的推理，根据事件叙述估计山洪深度类别，在大纽约案例中相对于专家估计达到 95.5% 的类别准确率。

details.en: DeepFlood converts unstructured flash-flood narratives into quantitative inundation-depth categories through reference-based LLM inference. The study evaluates multiple backbones, including ChatGPT and Gemini, and reports 95.5% flood-depth category accuracy and 92.4% reference-based reasoning accuracy for narratives from the Greater New York Metropolitan Area relative to domain-expert estimates. The resulting information is intended to support post-event flood assessment and urban flood-model validation where conventional observations are incomplete.
details.zh: DeepFlood 通过基于参考的 LLM 推理，将非结构化山洪叙述转换为定量的淹水深度类别。该研究评估了多个骨干模型，包括 ChatGPT 和 Gemini，并报告称，对于来自 Greater New York Metropolitan Area 的叙述，相对于领域专家估计，洪水深度类别准确率为 95.5%，基于参考的推理准确率为 92.4%。所得信息旨在支持事件后洪水评估以及城市洪水模型验证，尤其适用于传统观测数据不完整的情况。

limitations.en: The study is limited by validating inundation depths indirectly against expert-based pseudo-observations rather than measurements, relying on a reference dataset with limited coverage and temporal representativeness, evaluating only commercial ChatGPT and Gemini backbones, and focusing on the Greater New York area.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于使用专家伪观测而非实测数据间接验证淹水深度、依赖覆盖范围和时间代表性有限的参考数据集、仅评估商业化的 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 模型，以及研究范围局限于大纽约地区。

papers.title: Assessing Reliability of Large Language Model Outputs on Drinking Water Quality Data from Smart Water Distribution System
papers.venue: The Springer Series in Applied Machine Learning

summary.en: The chapter evaluates how reliably Gemini 1.5 and ChatGPT-4o interpret and recommend actions from real-time drinking-water quality measurements.
summary.zh: 本章评估 Gemini 1.5 和 ChatGPT-4o 对实时饮用水水质测量结果进行解读并提出行动建议的可靠性。

details.en: The study applies Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and ChatGPT-4o to real-time chlorine, pH, total dissolved solids, and temperature data from an IoT-enabled smart water distribution system at IIT Jodhpur. It focuses on checking the reliability of LLM-generated interpretations and recommendations against a real-world drinking-water dataset, providing foundational evidence for LLM-assisted water-quality assessment rather than an autonomous operational workflow.
details.zh: 该研究将 Gemini 1.5 Flash、Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 ChatGPT-4o 应用于来自 IIT Jodhpur 一个物联网智能供水系统的实时氯、pH、总溶解固体和温度数据。研究重点是根据真实世界的饮用水数据集，检验 LLM 生成的解读和建议的可靠性，为 LLM 辅助的水质评估提供基础性证据，而不是建立自主运行的工作流程。

papers.title: Large language model-driven decision-making for single-atom Fenton-like catalysts toward wastewater treatment

summary.en: An LLM workflow mines more than 1,000 catalyst publications and patents, then supports experimentally checked catalyst selection for advanced wastewater treatment.
summary.zh: 一个 LLM 工作流挖掘了超过 1,000 篇催化剂论文和专利，并支持经过实验验证的高级废水处理催化剂选择。

details.en: The study uses few-shot chain-of-thought prompting to extract synthesis, material-property, and performance knowledge from more than 1,000 publications and patents on Fenton-like single-atom catalysts. The structured knowledge is combined with machine-learning prediction and literature-grounded synthesis recommendations to select catalyst configurations for target wastewater conditions. Experiments are reported to confirm the performance of platform-recommended catalysts under realistic conditions.
details.zh: 该研究采用少样本思维链提示，从超过 1,000 篇关于类 Fenton 单原子催化剂的论文和专利中提取合成、材料性质和性能知识。研究将结构化知识与机器学习预测和基于文献的合成建议相结合，以针对目标废水条件选择催化剂配置。研究报告了相关实验，以确认平台推荐催化剂在真实条件下的性能。

papers.title: Integrating multi-source data and large language models in flood vulnerability curve analysis for buildings in mainland China

limitations.en: The main limitation is that independent post-disaster observations are unavailable to validate the predicted component loss ratios at matched flood depths, so the resulting curves are synthetic estimates rather than empirically verified national vulnerability functions.
limitations.zh: 该研究的主要局限是缺乏可在匹配洪水深度下验证预测构件损失率的独立灾后观测数据，因此所得曲线属于综合估计，而非经实证验证的全国性脆弱性函数。

papers.title: Automating SWMM-based stormwater modelling and analysis through a tool-augmented single-agent system

summary.en: SWMM-Agentic uses one LLM to orchestrate documented SWMM functions and completes 98.3% of a 60-task urban stormwater benchmark with the strongest tested model.
summary.zh: SWMM-Agentic 使用一个 LLM 编排有文档记录的 SWMM 函数，并使用测试中表现最强的模型完成了城市雨水基准测试中 60 项任务的 98.3%。

details.en: SWMM-Agentic couples a single LLM orchestration model with documented functions for inspecting, editing, running, and analysing an existing SWMM model through natural-language instructions. The authors evaluate 20 static, 20 dynamic, and 20 scenario-based tasks with three LLMs, yielding 180 runs; the strongest model completes 59 of 60 tasks, and 89 of 100 failed tool calls are followed by a successful corrective call within three attempts. The system also reproduces network characteristics, compares control strategies, and runs a human-framed rain-garden scenario for combined-sewer-overflow analysis, providing direct evidence for traceable LLM orchestration of urban stormwater modelling workflows.
details.zh: SWMM-Agentic 将单个 LLM 编排模型与有文档记录的函数相结合，通过自然语言指令检查、编辑、运行和分析现有的 SWMM 模型。作者使用三个 LLM 评估了 20 项静态任务、20 项动态任务和 20 项基于场景的任务，共进行 180 次运行；表现最强的模型完成了 60 项任务中的 59 项，并且 100 次失败的工具调用中有 89 次在三次尝试内随后通过成功的纠正调用完成。该系统还复现了网络特征、比较了控制策略，并运行了一个由人类构建的雨水花园场景，用于合流制溢流分析，为城市雨水建模工作流中可追溯的 LLM 编排提供了直接证据。

papers.title: Assessing the Benefits of Combining Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment from UAV Imagery

summary.en: A detector–LVLM pipeline classifies post-disaster building damage on FloodNet and RescueNet and reports gains over standalone baselines with limited detection annotations.
summary.zh: 一种检测器–LVLM流水线在FloodNet和RescueNet上对灾后建筑损毁进行分类，并在检测标注有限的情况下报告了相较于独立基线的性能提升。

details.en: The framework separates building detection from damage interpretation: a computer-vision detector supplies bounding boxes, and a large vision-language model classifies damage and adds contextual interpretation. Evaluation on FloodNet and RescueNet covers intact, partially damaged, and destroyed buildings, with the best configuration improving reported counting performance over isolated baselines. The paper also analyses failure cases and releases code and data.
details.zh: 该框架将建筑检测与损毁解读分开：计算机视觉检测器提供边界框，大型视觉语言模型对损毁进行分类并添加上下文解读。在FloodNet和RescueNet上的评估涵盖完好、部分损毁和完全毁坏的建筑，其中最佳配置提升了相较于独立基线所报告的计数性能。论文还分析了失败案例，并发布了代码和数据。

limitations.en: The study is limited by the U.S.- and event-specific datasets, potential spatial autocorrelation and data leakage across splits, insufficient information to assess annotation reliability, inconsistencies between FloodNet’s definition and labels, and the lack of domain-fine-tuned LVLMs or comparisons with fully supervised detectors.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性包括数据集仅覆盖美国且具有特定事件范围、数据划分之间可能存在空间自相关和数据泄漏、缺乏足以评估标注可靠性的信息、FloodNet定义与标注之间存在不一致，以及未采用领域微调的LVLM或与全监督检测器进行比较。

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Water Engineering and Research

details.en: The WaterER study introduces 983 benchmark tasks spanning wastewater treatment, environmental restoration, drinking-water treatment and distribution, sanitation, anaerobic digestion, and contaminants assessment. Seven LLMs are evaluated across these tasks to characterize their strengths and limitations as water-engineering expert models. This is enabling benchmark evidence rather than an agent implementation.
details.zh: WaterER 研究引入了涵盖废水处理、环境修复、饮用水处理与配送、卫生设施、厌氧消化和污染物评估的 983 项基准任务。在这些任务中对七个 LLM 进行评估，以刻画其作为水工程专家模型的优势和局限性。这是支持基准测试的证据，而不是代理实现。

limitations.en: The study acknowledges that current LLMs may not fully address complex water-engineering and research questions, with English-task accuracy below 80% and performance on Chinese water-engineering questions still unsuitable.
limitations.zh: 该研究承认，当前大型语言模型可能无法充分解决复杂的水工程与水研究问题，其英文任务准确率低于80%，在中文水工程问题上的表现也仍不适用。

papers.title: Naiad: Novel Agentic Intelligent Autonomous System for Inland Water Monitoring

details.en: NAIAD is an LLM-enabled inland-water monitoring assistant that combines retrieval-augmented generation, external-tool orchestration, computational graph execution, and agentic reflection. It integrates weather data, Sentinel-2 imagery, remote-sensing indices, chlorophyll-a estimation, and established monitoring tools. A dedicated benchmark evaluates correctness and relevance across different user-expertise levels, with an ablation across LLM backbones.
details.zh: NAIAD 是一个由 LLM 驱动的内陆水体监测助手，结合了检索增强生成、外部工具编排、计算图执行和智能体反思。它集成了天气数据、Sentinel-2 影像、遥感指数、叶绿素-a 估算以及成熟的监测工具。一个专门的基准测试评估不同用户专业水平下的正确性和相关性，并对不同 LLM 骨干模型进行了消融实验。

limitations.en: The study is limited in scope to three Greek lakes, the initial toolset and data modalities, and a single-agent architecture.
limitations.zh: 该研究的范围局限于希腊的三个湖泊、初始工具集和数据模态，以及单智能体架构。

papers.title: Mini-JEPA Foundation Model Fleet Enables Agentic Hydrologic Intelligence

details.en: The study proposes five sensor-specialized Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture foundation models routed by an LLM for hydrological questions. The models cover optical, radar, thermal, phenological, and topography-soil inputs; the evaluation reports predictive performance for elevation, temperature, precipitation, soil moisture, and aridity, together with a curated routing test and paired comparison against AlphaEarth-only retrieval.
details.zh: 该研究提出了五个由LLM为水文问题进行路由的、传感器专用的Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture基础模型。这些模型涵盖光学、雷达、热学、物候和地形-土壤输入；评估报告了海拔、温度、降水、土壤湿度和干旱度的预测性能，以及经过整理的路由测试和与仅使用AlphaEarth检索的配对比较。

limitations.en: The study is limited to a 9,704-patch CONUS corpus from a single year, may not transfer cleanly across climates, biomes, or years, uses a 40-question LLM-as-Judge evaluation with top-end score saturation and insufficient power for small effects, and is subject to judge-specific calibration and bias with imperfect inter-judge agreement.
limitations.zh: 该研究仅基于覆盖美国本土、单个年份的9,704个样本块，可能无法直接推广到不同气候、生态群系或年份；其包含40个问题的LLM评审易出现高分饱和、难以分辨较小效应，并受到评审者特定的校准偏差及评审者间不完全一致的影响。

papers.title: MARLIN: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Murmuration Intelligence and LLM Guidance for Reservoir Management

details.en: MARLIN combines decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning with an LLM that supplies real-time reward-shaping signals for reservoir management under physical-transfer and environmental uncertainty. Experiments using USGS data report uncertainty, computation, response-time, and scaling outcomes. It is retained as a hybrid LLM-guided reservoir system and distinguished from classical non-LLM MARL.
details.zh: MARLIN 将去中心化多智能体强化学习与一个 LLM 相结合，由该 LLM 为不确定的物理传输和环境条件下的水库管理提供实时奖励塑形信号。使用 USGS 数据的实验报告了不确定性、计算、响应时间和扩展性结果。它被保留为一种混合型 LLM 引导的水库系统，并与经典的非 LLM MARL 区分开来。

limitations.en: The study is limited because the LLM adjusts murmuration weights using predefined scenario templates, and evaluation by actual water-resource managers and hydrologists remains limited.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于，LLM依据预定义的情景模板调整群集协同行为权重，且实际水资源管理者和水文学家的评估仍然有限。

papers.title: InsurAgent: A Large Language Model-Empowered Agent for Simulating Individual Behavior in Purchasing Flood Insurance

details.en: The study evaluates large language models for flood-insurance purchase probabilities and proposes InsurAgent, an LLM-empowered system with perception, retrieval, reasoning, action, and memory modules. Retrieval-augmented generation grounds decisions in survey data, while memory supports temporal simulations of individual decisions. The work directly addresses behavioural modelling and policy analysis in a flood-risk context.
details.zh: 该研究评估了大型语言模型在洪水保险购买概率预测中的表现，并提出了 InsurAgent——一个由 LLM 驱动的系统，包含感知、检索、推理、行动和记忆模块。检索增强生成使决策以调查数据为依据，而记忆模块支持对个体决策进行时间模拟。该工作直接针对洪水风险背景下的行为建模和政策分析。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its reliance on a single region-specific empirical dataset, the lack of validation for extrapolations beyond survey data, and its focus on individual rather than multi-agent or population-level decision-making.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于依赖单一地区的实证数据集、缺乏对超出调查数据范围的外推结果的验证，以及仅关注个体层面而非多智能体或群体层面的决策。

papers.title: AI-Driven Framework for Adaptive Water Network Management with Proof-of-Concept Implementation: Addressing Non-Revenue Water in Jordan

details.en: The study integrates EPANET hydraulic modelling, a digital-twin concept, SCADA, retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, and LLM-based agents for continuous water-network monitoring and adaptive decision support. A proof-of-concept uses offline LLMs and EPYT on a 1,164-junction Amman network and reports automated simulation, anomaly detection, burst localization, and report generation outcomes.
details.zh: 该研究整合了EPANET水力建模、数字孪生概念、SCADA、检索增强生成、函数调用以及基于LLM的智能体，用于持续监测供水网络和提供自适应决策支持。概念验证在包含1,164个节点的Amman网络上使用离线LLM和EPYT，并报告了自动化模拟、异常检测、爆管定位和报告生成结果。

limitations.en: The proof-of-concept is limited to monitoring and decision support, while autonomous control, full RAG, function calling, safety interlocks, SCADA integration, and multi-agent coordination remain undeveloped.
limitations.zh: 该概念验证仅限于监测和决策支持，而自主控制、完整的检索增强生成、函数调用、安全联锁、SCADA 集成和多智能体协同仍有待开发。

papers.title: Wikimpacts 1.0: a new global climate impact database based on automated information extraction from Wikipedia

summary.en: Wikimpacts 1.0 uses GPT-4o to extract 2,726 climate-extreme events from Wikipedia into a global multiscale impact database evaluated against 156 manually annotated events.
summary.zh: Wikimpacts 1.0 使用 GPT-4o 从 Wikipedia 中提取了 2,726 起气候极端事件，构建了一个全球多尺度影响数据库，并以 156 起人工标注事件进行评估。

details.en: Wikimpacts 1.0 uses GPT-4o in an automated pipeline that identifies relevant English Wikipedia articles and extracts, normalizes, geolocates, and stores impacts from floods, droughts, storms, heatwaves, wildfires, and other climate extremes. The database covers 2,726 events from 1034 to 2024, with 17,912 national and 32,343 subnational records. Comparison with 156 manually annotated events reports low error scores for timing, deaths, and economic damage but higher errors for homelessness, displacement, injuries, and damaged buildings, making the work useful evidence for LLM-assisted hydroclimate impact extraction.
details.zh: Wikimpacts 1.0 在自动化流程中使用 GPT-4o，识别相关的英文 Wikipedia 文章，并提取、规范化、地理定位和存储洪水、干旱、风暴、热浪、野火及其他气候极端事件的影响。该数据库涵盖 1034 年至 2024 年的 2,726 起事件，包括 17,912 条国家级记录和 32,343 条次国家级记录。与 156 起人工标注事件的比较显示，时间、死亡人数和经济损失的误差分数较低，但无家可归、流离失所、受伤人数和受损建筑物的误差较高，使这项工作成为 LLM 辅助水文气候影响提取的有用证据。

limitations.en: The study acknowledges uneven geographical and hazard-category coverage, missing impact data and sparse pre-1900 records, errors and model sensitivity in LLM-based extraction, absent lower-level hazard and indirect or cascading impacts, and dependence on Wikipedia’s quality.
limitations.zh: 该研究承认其存在地理和灾害类别覆盖不均、影响数据缺失及1900年前记录稀少、基于大语言模型的信息提取存在错误且对模型敏感、缺少较低层级的灾害信息和间接或级联影响，以及依赖维基百科信息质量等局限。

papers.title: MAESTRO: large language model-enabled cross-agency coordination for natural disaster early warning

summary.en: MAESTRO coordinates typhoon early-warning work across agencies through role-based LLM agents, grounded tools, and human oversight, matching expert alert levels in 98% of 100 scenarios.
summary.zh: MAESTRO通过基于角色的LLM代理、基于依据的工具和人工监督，协调各机构间的台风预警工作，在100个场景中的98%与专家警报级别相匹配。

details.en: MAESTRO mirrors institutional roles with multiple LLM-enabled agents that reconcile agency terminology, call grounded forecasting and impact tools, and assemble cross-agency early-warning actions under human oversight. Across 100 typhoon scenarios it matched expert alert levels in 98% of cases and reduced decision latency by more than 85%. A 72-hour Typhoon Lekima replay yielded eight additional hours of lead time for relocating about 180,000 residents, and the system was used in a provincial government platform during multiple typhoon responses over one year.
details.zh: MAESTRO通过多个支持LLM的代理模拟机构角色，这些代理协调机构术语，调用基于依据的预测和影响工具，并在人工监督下汇总跨机构预警行动。在100个台风场景中，它在98%的情况下与专家警报级别相匹配，并将决策延迟缩短了超过85%。对Typhoon Lekima进行的72小时重演为转移约180,000名居民额外争取了八小时的提前时间；该系统还曾在一年内多次台风响应期间用于一个省级政府平台。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its emphasis on latency, lead time, and evacuees moved rather than prospective impact and counterfactual outcome metrics; its focus on meteorology, hydrology, and core lifelines; the absence of a full cost–benefit analysis; the need for region-specific integration; unavoidable residual uncertainty; and its agency-facing rather than direct-to-public warning scope.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于主要关注延迟、提前预警时间和转移人数，而未采用前瞻性的影响指标和反事实结果评估；研究范围集中于气象、水文及核心生命线系统；尚未开展完整的成本效益分析；在新地区部署需要针对性集成；多机构灾害系统存在不可避免的残余不确定性；且研究仅覆盖面向机构的预警，而非直接面向公众的预警。

papers.title: Improving flood detection with large-scale dashboard camera data

summary.en: BayFlood uses a vision-language model to screen 1,440,184 dashboard-camera images, revealing urban floods and coverage biases missed by existing reporting and sensor networks.
summary.zh: BayFlood 使用视觉语言模型筛查 1,440,184 张仪表盘摄像头图像，揭示了现有报告和传感器网络遗漏的城市洪水及覆盖偏差。

details.en: BayFlood applies a vision-language model to street-level dashboard-camera imagery for fine-grained urban flood detection without requiring a large labelled flood-image dataset. Validation across 1,440,184 images and multiple cities shows correspondence with external flood-risk predictors. In New York City, the method identifies flooding in neighbourhoods overlooked by existing approaches, detects demographic bias in current coverage, and suggests candidate locations for new flood sensors.
details.zh: BayFlood 将视觉语言模型应用于街道级仪表盘摄像头图像，以进行细粒度的城市洪水检测，而无需大型标注洪水图像数据集。在 1,440,184 张图像和多个城市中的验证显示，其结果与外部洪水风险预测因子相一致。在纽约市，该方法识别出现有方法遗漏的社区中的洪水，检测出当前覆盖范围中的人口统计学偏差，并为新增洪水传感器提出候选位置。

papers.title: GeoRisk-MLLM: A Multimodal Large Language Model Framework for Natural Disaster Risk Detection and Early Warning in Geoscience

summary.en: GeoRisk-MLLM fuses remote-sensing, time-series, and IoT inputs to generate interpretable multi-hazard risk assessments, reporting an average AUC of 0.934 across three benchmarks.
summary.zh: GeoRisk-MLLM 融合遥感、时间序列和 IoT 输入，以生成可解释的多灾种风险评估，在三个基准测试中报告了 0.934 的平均 AUC。

details.en: GeoRisk-MLLM combines a multimodal spatiotemporal encoder, risk-aware reasoning alignment, and compressed edge inference for earthquake, landslide, and flood risk detection and early warning. It aligns imagery and monitoring streams with generated risk reports and uses cache compression and knowledge distillation for resource-constrained deployment. Across three geoscience benchmarks, the preprint reports an average AUC of 0.934 and human ratings that support the interpretability and actionability of its reports.
details.zh: GeoRisk-MLLM 结合了多模态时空编码器、风险感知推理对齐和压缩边缘推理，用于地震、滑坡和洪水风险检测与预警。它将影像和监测流与生成的风险报告进行对齐，并使用缓存压缩和知识蒸馏实现资源受限部署。在三个地球科学基准测试中，该预印本报告了 0.934 的平均 AUC，以及支持其报告可解释性和可操作性的人类评分。

papers.title: CFDID: a China Flood Disaster Impact Database from 1994 to 2023

summary.en: CFDID combines OCR, LLM extraction, and manual verification to structure 1,716 Chinese flood-impact records from 66 official documents covering 1994–2023.
summary.zh: CFDID结合OCR、LLM提取和人工核验，对来自66份官方文件、涵盖1994–2023年的1,716条中国洪灾影响记录进行结构化处理。

details.en: CFDID contains 1,716 flood-disaster event records, including 1,391 top-level events, compiled from 66 Chinese official documents. Its workflow combines optical character recognition, LLM-based information extraction, and manual verification to capture dates, locations, disaster categories, eight impact indicators, and source provenance. The database covers rainstorm, typhoon, snowmelt, ice-jam, and dam-break floods and reports substantial coverage of national annual totals for casualties, affected population and cropland, collapsed dwellings, and direct economic losses.
details.zh: CFDID包含1,716条洪灾事件记录，其中包括1,391条顶层事件，汇编自66份中国官方文件。其工作流程结合光学字符识别、基于LLM的信息提取和人工核验，以获取日期、地点、灾害类别、八项影响指标和来源出处。该数据库涵盖暴雨、台风、融雪、冰坝和溃坝洪水，并报告了人员伤亡、受影响人口和耕地、倒塌房屋以及直接经济损失等全国年度总量的大量数据。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its reliance mainly on national-level official records, which may omit small or local events; incomplete spatial disaggregation and lack of precise coordinates; inability to separate typhoon impacts into wind, water, and related hazards or consistently distinguish flood-related geological hazards; classification by triggering cause rather than common flood subtypes; and provision only in tabular form.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于主要依赖国家层面的官方记录，可能遗漏小规模或地方性事件；空间分解不完整且缺乏精确坐标；无法将台风影响区分为风、洪水及相关次生灾害，也无法始终将与洪水相关的地质灾害分离；按触发原因而非常见洪水亚型进行分类；且目前仅以表格形式提供。

papers.title: A progressive fine-tuning strategy for domain-specific large language models in wastewater treatment plants safety

summary.en: Progressive fine-tuning, vLLM deployment, and preference optimization produce a domain-specific LLM for wastewater-treatment-plant safety knowledge and professional tasks.
summary.zh: 渐进式微调、vLLM部署和偏好优化生成了一个面向污水处理厂安全知识和专业任务的领域专用LLM。

details.en: The study constructs a wastewater-treatment-plant safety dataset and partitions domain knowledge into sequential fine-tuning stages so that the LLM consolidates core safety knowledge while reducing catastrophic forgetting and cross-task conflicts. The model is deployed with vLLM and further optimized through direct preference optimization. Reported experiments show stronger adherence to safety protocols and domain understanding than conventional multi-task fine-tuning and larger general-purpose models on the evaluated tasks.
details.zh: 该研究构建了一个污水处理厂安全数据集，并将领域知识划分为连续的微调阶段，使LLM在巩固核心安全知识的同时，减少灾难性遗忘和跨任务冲突。该模型使用vLLM进行部署，并通过直接偏好优化进一步优化。报告的实验表明，在所评估的任务上，与传统的多任务微调模型和更大型的通用模型相比，该模型对安全规程的遵循程度更高，领域理解能力更强。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its reliance on static text-based knowledge representations rather than multimodal information such as real-time sensor data, process images, and video surveillance.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限在于依赖静态文本知识表示，而未纳入实时传感器数据、工艺图像和视频监控等多模态信息。

papers.title: A Hybrid LLM-enhanced Water Resources Decision Chain Hypergraph Transformer for Coordinated Reservoir Group Operation

summary.en: An LLM completes implicit nodes and cross-stage relations in a decision-chain hypergraph that classifies coordinated reservoir-operation priorities with a Macro-F1 of 0.9408.
summary.zh: LLM在决策链超图中补全隐式节点和跨阶段关系，对协调水库运行优先级进行分类，Macro-F1达到0.9408。

details.en: WRDC-HGT represents reservoir-group operation as a six-node decision chain spanning drivers, hydrological responses, reservoir states, demand sectors, management conflicts, and operation responses. A hybrid LLM completes implicit nodes and cross-stage relations on a rule-based chain skeleton, after which DeBERTa, graph propagation, and hypergraph propagation identify operating priorities. On a multi-source event dataset, the system achieved 0.9392 accuracy, 0.9408 Macro-F1, and 0.9624 recall for high-priority operations across flood-control, water-supply, and ecological objectives.
details.zh: WRDC-HGT将水库群运行表示为一条包含六个节点的决策链，涵盖驱动因素、水文响应、水库状态、需求部门、管理冲突和运行响应。混合LLM在基于规则的链骨架上补全隐式节点和跨阶段关系，随后DeBERTa、图传播和超图传播识别运行优先级。在一个多源事件数据集上，该系统在防洪、供水和生态目标方面取得了0.9392的准确率、0.9408的Macro-F1，以及对高优先级运行的0.9624召回率。

limitations.en: The study’s applicability remains limited because it does not yet integrate real reservoir-operation data, physical constraints, or digital-twin models for cross-basin, cross-timescale, and online operation-decision scenarios.
limitations.zh: 该研究的适用性仍受到限制，因为目前尚未整合真实水库运行数据、物理约束或数字孪生模型，以支持跨流域、跨时间尺度和在线运行决策场景。

papers.title: A Blueprint for Modern Floodplain Management: System Requirements and Architecture for AI-Ready Platforms

summary.en: A U.S. floodplain-management needs assessment translates local workflow and regulatory bottlenecks into requirements for AI-ready platforms and localized RAG assistants.
summary.zh: 美国洪泛区管理需求评估将地方工作流程和监管瓶颈转化为对适用于AI的平台和本地化RAG助手的需求。

details.en: The preprint synthesizes U.S. local ordinances, consultations with floodplain-management professionals, and community validation to identify fragmented mapping, manual documentation, regulatory complexity, communication barriers, and uneven capacity. It proposes a conceptual platform architecture with local or client-side computation, machine-readable regulatory datasets, interoperable GIS and hydrologic services, and localized RAG assistants for permit review, public inquiries, and emergency preparedness.
details.zh: 该预印本综合了美国地方条例、与洪泛区管理专业人员的咨询以及社区验证，以识别碎片化制图、手动文档编制、监管复杂性、沟通障碍和能力不均衡等问题。该研究提出了一种概念性平台架构，包括本地或客户端计算、机器可读的监管数据集、可互操作的GIS和水文服务，以及用于许可审查、公众咨询和应急准备的本地化RAG助手。

limitations.en: The domain engagement was limited by the project timeline and the availability of professionals, resulting in consultations that did not cover a broader range of U.S. jurisdictions.
limitations.zh: 受项目时间安排和专业人员可获得性的限制，本研究的领域参与未涵盖更广泛的美国辖区。

papers.title: WaterCopilot: An AI-Driven Virtual Assistant for Water Management

summary.en: WaterCopilot combines RAG with two tool-calling plugins to query Limpopo Basin documents and live hydrological services, producing referenced alerts, calculations, and visualizations.
summary.zh: WaterCopilot 将 RAG 与两个工具调用插件相结合，用于查询林波波河流域文档和实时水文服务，生成带有参考来源的预警、计算结果和可视化内容。

details.en: Developed by IWMI and Microsoft Research, WaterCopilot connects a document-search plugin to indexed policy material and an API plugin to live rainfall, reservoir, environmental-flow, water-accounting, and irrigation data for the Limpopo River Basin. It supports multilingual guided queries, automatic calculations, visual outputs, source references, and links to the basin digital twin. A RAGAS evaluation reports an overall score of 0.8043, including answer relevancy of 0.8571 and context precision of 0.8009, making this a direct example of an LLM assistant coordinating information and data services for transboundary water management.
details.zh: WaterCopilot 由 IWMI 和 Microsoft Research 开发，将文档搜索插件连接到已建立索引的政策材料，并将 API 插件连接到林波波河流域的实时降雨、水库、生态流量、水资源核算和灌溉数据。它支持多语言引导式查询、自动计算、可视化输出、来源引用以及通往流域数字孪生的链接。RAGAS 评估报告显示，其总体得分为 0.8043，其中答案相关性为 0.8571，上下文精确度为 0.8009，因此这是一个 LLM 助手协调信息和数据服务以支持跨界水资源管理的直接示例。

limitations.en: The study reports limitations in extracting tables and images from indexed documents, dependence on GPT-based models, variable multilingual accuracy, limited processing of non-English technical documents, API latency, and evaluation based mainly on LLM-generated RAGAS metrics without extended human assessment.
limitations.zh: 该研究报告的局限性包括无法从索引文档中提取表格和图像、依赖基于GPT的模型、多语言准确性不稳定、处理非英语技术文档的能力有限、API延迟，以及评估主要依赖基于大语言模型生成的RAGAS指标而缺乏广泛的人类评估。

papers.title: Use of ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek to improve the usability and reproducibility of computational software in hydraulics
papers.venue: University of Thessaly Institutional Repository (University of Thessaly)

summary.en: A civil-engineering thesis compares ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek on friction-factor and shallow-water-equation tasks, emphasizing numerical reliability, self-correction, and reproducibility.
summary.zh: 一篇土木工程学位论文比较了 ChatGPT、Claude 和 DeepSeek 在摩阻系数和浅水方程任务上的表现，重点关注数值可靠性、自我纠错和可复现性。

details.en: The thesis evaluates the three LLMs on Darcy-Weisbach friction-factor calculation, an analytically solvable shallow-water-equation problem, and steady two-dimensional shallow-water flow with checks on generated plots. It compares final answers, error patterns, corrective interventions, theoretical adequacy, physical consistency, and practical usability as support tools for computational hydraulics. The work is relevant as a direct test of foundational LLM capability in hydraulic computation rather than an Agent that coordinates a larger workflow.
details.zh: 该学位论文评估了这三个 LLM 在 Darcy-Weisbach 摩阻系数计算、一个可解析求解的浅水方程问题，以及带有生成图检查的稳态二维浅水流方面的表现。论文比较了最终答案、错误模式、纠正干预、理论充分性、物理一致性，以及作为计算水力学支持工具的实际可用性。这项工作具有相关性，因为它直接测试了 LLM 在水力计算中的基础能力，而不是测试一个协调更大工作流的 Agent。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its evaluation of only three representative hydraulic problems, its predominantly technical and qualitative assessment, and its use of web interfaces that did not allow control of the models’ stochastic generation parameters.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于仅评估了三个具有代表性的水力学问题，主要采用技术性和定性评价，并通过无法控制模型随机生成参数的网页界面开展实验。

papers.title: TransResAI: A Compound AI System for Coastal Transportation Resilience

summary.en: TransResAI combines a local LLM, RAG, secure code generation, geospatial analysis, and flood-scenario data to accelerate coastal transportation-resilience analysis.
summary.zh: TransResAI结合本地LLM、RAG、安全代码生成、地理空间分析和洪水情景数据，加速沿海交通韧性分析。

details.en: The compound AI system decomposes natural-language requests, generates and executes constrained analysis code, retrieves regional documents, analyzes MATSim flood scenarios and OpenStreetMap-derived flood-risk networks, incorporates equity indicators, and renders interactive maps for Hampton Roads, Virginia. In a structured domain-expert study, it reduced analytical and visualization task time by 80–88%, maintained mean accuracy of 4.60 out of 5, and achieved task-completion rates above 94%. The contribution is a tested interface between LLM orchestration and quantitative coastal-flood infrastructure analysis rather than a standalone chatbot.
details.zh: 该复合AI系统分解自然语言请求，生成并执行受约束的分析代码，检索区域文档，分析MATSim洪水情景和源自OpenStreetMap的洪水风险网络，纳入公平性指标，并为弗吉尼亚州汉普顿路地区呈现交互式地图。在一项结构化领域专家研究中，该系统将分析和可视化任务的耗时减少了80–88%，保持了4.60（满分5分）的平均准确率，并实现了超过94%的任务完成率。该贡献是LLM编排与定量沿海洪水基础设施分析之间经过测试的接口，而非独立的聊天机器人。

limitations.en: The study’s generalizability remains limited because the framework was evaluated only in the Hampton Roads region and for coastal flooding.
limitations.zh: 由于该框架仅在汉普顿路地区并针对沿海洪涝进行了评估，本研究的普适性仍然有限。

papers.title: Sustainable Water Management Strategies
papers.venue: Sustainable Agriculture Applications Using Large Language Models

summary.en: This chapter surveys how LLMs could support water-resource decisions through text analysis, predictive-model assistance, and applications in floods, water quality, and agricultural water management.
summary.zh: 本章综述了LLM如何通过文本分析、预测模型辅助以及在洪水、水质和农业水资源管理中的应用来支持水资源决策。

details.en: The chapter organizes prospective and reported LLM uses across flood forecasting, water-quality monitoring, agricultural water management, predictive modelling, and decision support. It also discusses dependencies on data quality and computing resources and the need to address ethical and policy questions when linking LLMs with technologies such as IoT systems. The record is useful as cross-domain conceptual context for the water sector rather than as evidence of one implemented Agent workflow.
details.zh: 本章整理了LLM在洪水预报、水质监测、农业水资源管理、预测建模和决策支持方面的预期用途及已有报道。还讨论了对数据质量和计算资源的依赖，以及将LLM与IoT系统等技术连接时需要解决的伦理和政策问题。作为水资源领域的跨领域概念背景资料，该记录很有用，但不能作为某一已实施Agent工作流的证据。

papers.title: Probabilistic Seasonal Streamflow Forecasting Across California's Sierra Nevada Watersheds with Agentic AI

summary.en: An LLM agent and automated code-mutation system developed seasonal streamflow models that reduced watershed-averaged quantile forecast error by up to 29% against California Bulletin 120 forecasts.
summary.zh: 一个LLM代理和自动化代码变异系统开发了季节性流量模型，使流域平均分位数预测误差相比California Bulletin 120预报最多降低了29%。

details.en: The workflow uses an LLM-powered agent to discover datasets, synthesize hydrological knowledge from forecasting competitions and literature, and explore model architectures. A second LLM-powered system applies Monte Carlo Tree Search over code mutations. Their resulting adaptive ensemble combines three XGBoost quantile-regression models with physics-informed features to forecast monthly full natural flow at one- to six-month lead times for 23 Sierra Nevada watersheds. Against operational Bulletin 120 forecasts for 2021–2025, the agent-developed system reports its largest gains for early-season cumulative April–July runoff predictions.
details.zh: 该工作流使用由LLM驱动的代理来发现数据集、从预测竞赛和文献中综合水文知识，并探索模型架构。第二个由LLM驱动的系统对代码变异应用Monte Carlo Tree Search。其生成的自适应集成模型结合了三个XGBoost分位数回归模型和物理信息特征，用于预测23个Sierra Nevada流域提前一至六个月的月度全天然径流。与2021–2025年的运行Bulletin 120预报相比，该代理开发的系统在季初累计4月至7月径流预测中报告了最大增益。

limitations.en: The study notes that its data-centric estimators are untested for fundamentally unprecedented scenarios, that monthly integration obscures sub-monthly phenomena such as atmospheric rivers and rapid rain-on-snow melt pulses, and that it does not use subseasonal weather forecasts that could improve monthly skill.
limitations.zh: 该研究指出，其数据驱动估计器尚未在根本上前所未有的情景下接受检验，月尺度整合会掩盖大气河和快速雨雪融化脉冲等月内现象，且未使用可能提升月尺度预测技巧的次季节天气预报。

papers.title: Multi-agent large language model frameworks: Unlocking new possibilities for optimizing wastewater treatment operation

summary.en: This perspective proposes tool-equipped, specialized LLM agents for wastewater-treatment decision support and uses sludge bulking to illustrate how coordinated agents could combine heterogeneous plant data with human oversight.
summary.zh: 该观点文章提出配备工具的专业化 LLM 智能体，用于废水处理决策支持，并以污泥膨胀为例说明协调的智能体如何将异构污水处理厂数据与人工监督相结合。

details.en: The paper argues that wastewater-treatment operation requires multiple specialized, tool-equipped LLM agents because a single model cannot reliably integrate the biological, chemical, physical and unstructured information involved in plant decisions. It presents a sludge-bulking case to illustrate collaborative analysis and targeted recommendations, while framing process-control benefits as prospective rather than a validated autonomous deployment. It explicitly identifies computational cost, decision risk, validation, interpretability and human oversight as implementation constraints.
details.zh: 该论文认为，废水处理运行需要多个配备工具的专业化 LLM 智能体，因为单个模型无法可靠地整合污水处理厂决策所涉及的生物、化学、物理和非结构化信息。论文以污泥膨胀案例说明协作分析和针对性建议，同时将过程控制收益界定为预期收益，而非经过验证的自主部署成果。论文明确指出，计算成本、决策风险、验证、可解释性和人工监督是实施约束。

papers.title: Mapping Water: A Brief History of GIS in Hydrology and a Path Toward AI-Native Modeling

summary.en: This hydrology review organizes AI integration into four levels, from conversational GIS assistance to agents that reason directly over spatial water data and professional models.
summary.zh: 这篇水文学综述将人工智能集成划分为四个层级，从对话式 GIS 辅助到直接对空间水数据和专业模型进行推理的智能体。

details.en: The article traces seven decades of increasing coupling between GIS and hydrological models, then proposes a four-level path toward AI-native spatial water intelligence. Near-term levels retain established GIS and simulation tools while LLM interfaces help formulate queries and invoke functions; later levels envisage agents reasoning over spatially organized observations, geofabrics, and hydrological model outputs through interoperable tool frameworks such as MCP. The review stresses that open data, maintainable software, domain understanding, and institutional capacity are prerequisites for moving from research demonstrations to operational water management.
details.zh: 文章追溯了 GIS 与水文模型之间不断加深耦合的七十年历程，随后提出了迈向 AI 原生空间水智能的四级路径。近期层级保留成熟的 GIS 和模拟工具，同时由 LLM 接口帮助构建查询并调用函数；后续层级设想智能体通过 MCP 等可互操作的工具框架，对按空间组织的观测数据、地理织物和水文模型输出进行推理。综述强调，开放数据、可维护的软件、领域理解和机构能力，是从研究演示迈向运营水管理的先决条件。

papers.title: Lightweight graph retrieval-augmented generation agent for safety monitoring digital twins in small- and medium-scale hydropower projects

summary.en: A Gemma-3-4B and GraphRAG agent retrieves monitoring evidence and invokes bounded safety-monitoring digital-twin functions in a field-deployed hydropower project.
summary.zh: 一个 Gemma-3-4B 和 GraphRAG 智能体在一个现场部署的水电项目中检索监测证据，并调用有界安全监测数字孪生函数。

details.en: The assistant grounds a quantized Gemma-3-4B model in a system-function-oriented knowledge graph for a medium-scale hydropower safety-monitoring digital twin. It accepts text or speech instructions, retrieves monitoring information, controls visualizations, invokes predefined system functions, corrects speech-recognition errors, and maintains the graph incrementally. Across 500 instructions, the study reports overall F1 of 0.962 and 100% recall for system-operation tasks. Field tests report 6.5-fold faster simple operations and 4.5-fold faster complex retrieval than manual interaction, with 4.8 GB peak GPU memory and mean response time of 1.5 seconds on a GTX 1060-class device.
details.zh: 该助手将量化的 Gemma-3-4B 模型置于面向系统功能的中型水电安全监测数字孪生知识图谱中。它接受文本或语音指令，检索监测信息，控制可视化，调用预定义的系统函数，纠正语音识别错误，并增量维护图谱。在 500 条指令中，该研究报告系统操作任务的总体 F1 为 0.962，召回率为 100%。现场测试报告称，与人工交互相比，简单操作速度提高 6.5 倍，复杂检索速度提高 4.5 倍；在 GTX 1060 级设备上，GPU 峰值内存为 4.8 GB，平均响应时间为 1.5 秒。

papers.title: Large-Language-Model-Assisted Microbial Source Tracking Reveals Mechanisms of Tropical Cyclone Impacts on Microbial Water Quality in Coastal Environments

summary.en: LAMST uses Llama 3-8B to turn unstructured microbial metadata into marine, terrestrial, wastewater, or insufficient-evidence source classes for post-cyclone coastal water-quality assessment.
summary.zh: LAMST 使用 Llama 3-8B 将非结构化微生物元数据转换为海洋、陆地、废水或证据不足的来源类别，用于飓风过后沿海水质评估。

details.en: The study combines 16S rRNA sequencing with NCBI BioSample metadata and uses Llama 3-8B to classify the likely environmental origin of detected taxa. Applied at 30 Florida Gulf Coast sites after Hurricane Milton, the resulting source fractions help distinguish terrestrial and wastewater associations with enterococci and resistance genes from marine associations with Vibrio parahaemolyticus. The framework is validated on reference samples from marine, terrestrial, and wastewater environments and illustrates a substantive standalone-LLM role in converting unstructured biological records into inputs for water-quality analysis.
details.zh: 该研究将 16S rRNA 测序与 NCBI BioSample 元数据相结合，并使用 Llama 3-8B 对检测到的分类单元可能的环境来源进行分类。在飓风 Milton 过后应用于 Florida Gulf Coast 的 30 个地点，所得来源比例有助于区分肠球菌和耐药基因与陆地和废水的关联，以及与 Vibrio parahaemolyticus 的海洋关联。该框架在来自海洋、陆地和废水环境的参考样本上得到验证，并展示了独立 LLM 在将非结构化生物记录转换为水质分析输入方面的实质性作用。

papers.title: Integrating Inverse Prompting and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Automated Flood Control Text Generation: A Case Study of the Lixiahe Region

summary.en: A DeepSeek-R1 IP-CoT pipeline extracts hydrological variables and generates constrained flood-control briefings from 1,260 Lixiahe monitoring records.
summary.zh: 一个 DeepSeek-R1 IP-CoT 流程从 1,260 条 Lixiahe 监测记录中提取水文变量，并生成受约束的防洪简报。

details.en: The method combines structured extraction of water levels, rainfall, risk levels, and flood-control measures with chain-of-thought reasoning, inverse prompting, beam search, and rule-based consistency checks. It is evaluated on 1,260 flood-control records from the Lixiahe river network covering 2010–2024. The paper reports 95.32% verification accuracy for positive emotional attributes, improved thematic fluency and diversity over baselines, and an inference time compatible with hourly or three-hour briefing cycles. The system targets preparation of operational flood-control text while retaining explicit intermediate reasoning and post-generation checks.
details.zh: 该方法将水位、降雨量、风险等级和防洪措施的结构化提取与思维链推理、逆向提示、束搜索和基于规则的一致性检查相结合。该方法在来自 Lixiahe 河网、覆盖 2010–2024 年的 1,260 条防洪记录上进行评估。论文报告称，正向情感属性的验证准确率为 95.32%，与基线相比，主题流畅性和多样性均有所提升，并且推理时间适用于每小时或每三小时的简报周期。该系统旨在编写运行层面的防洪文本，同时保留明确的中间推理和生成后的检查。

limitations.en: The study is limited by its dependence on the quality and scale of the annotated corpus, uncertain scalability to data-scarce basins, relatively high inference costs that may hinder deployment on resource-limited edge devices, and the need for manual fine-tuning in complex multi-river scenarios.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖带标注语料库的质量和规模，对数据稀缺流域的可扩展性尚不明确，较高的推理成本可能妨碍在资源受限的边缘设备上部署，并且复杂多河流场景仍需人工微调。

papers.title: Identification of tropical cyclone–related flash floods from hazard narratives using a large language model–based approach

summary.en: A validated two-LLM pipeline extracts causal factors from U.S. hazard narratives and identifies 6,470 flash floods associated with 135 tropical cyclones.
summary.zh: 一个经过验证的双LLM流程从美国灾害叙述中提取致因，并识别出与135个热带气旋相关的6,470次山洪。

details.en: The study processes National Centers for Environmental Information Storm Events narratives with two LLMs and validation procedures to extract flash-flood contributing factors and classify them as tropical-cyclone-related or external weather and environmental influences. Applied to 2007–2024 records, it identifies 6,470 related flash floods across the contiguous United States and shows that events shaped mainly by cyclone processes occur closer to cyclone tracks, whereas externally influenced events extend farther beyond conventional rainfall ranges. The contribution is large-scale hydrometeorological information extraction and attribution, not real-time flood forecasting.
details.zh: 该研究使用两个LLM和验证程序处理National Centers for Environmental Information Storm Events叙述，提取山洪致因，并将其分类为与热带气旋相关的因素或外部天气和环境影响。应用于2007–2024年的记录后，该研究在美国本土识别出6,470次相关山洪，并表明主要受气旋过程影响的事件发生位置更靠近气旋路径，而受外部因素影响的事件则超出传统降雨范围延伸得更远。该研究的贡献在于大规模水文气象信息提取与归因，而非实时洪水预报。

limitations.en: The study is limited by biases and limitations in hazard narratives, ambiguity and uncertainty in LLM extraction that may omit implicit factors, and complex spatial and temporal relationships within episodes that are not fully captured.
limitations.zh: 该研究的局限性在于灾害报告叙述存在偏差和局限，LLM提取存在可能遗漏隐含因素的歧义性和不确定性，以及事件过程中的复杂时空关系尚未被充分刻画。

papers.title: HydroVerse Education: An AI-Assisted Education Framework for Immersive Learning and Training Environments

summary.en: HydroVerse Education places a generative-AI virtual instructor inside an immersive hydroinformatics classroom for voice-based guidance through water-system scenarios.
summary.zh: HydroVerse Education 将生成式 AI 虚拟教师置于沉浸式水文信息学课堂中，通过基于语音的指导带领学习者完成水系统场景学习。

details.en: The platform combines Unreal Engine, Metahuman, virtual reality, and generative AI to provide real-time voice interaction and personalized guidance in simulated hydroinformatics learning environments. Its intended role is to help learners connect water-system theory with interactive scenarios and to lower the cost and access barriers of advanced training. This is an LLM-adjacent education and capacity-building application rather than an Agent executing hydrological models or operational water decisions.
details.zh: 该平台结合 Unreal Engine、Metahuman、虚拟现实和生成式 AI，在模拟的水文信息学学习环境中提供实时语音交互和个性化指导。其预期作用是帮助学习者将水系统理论与交互式场景联系起来，并降低高级培训的成本和准入门槛。这是一种与 LLM 相邻的教育和能力建设应用，而不是执行水文模型或运营性水决策的 Agent。

limitations.en: The HydroVerse immersive classroom is limited by its high technical and logistical demands, unequal access to suitable hardware and reliable internet, challenges in supporting diverse learners and technological proficiency, and digital avatars’ lack of human qualities such as empathy, motivation, and inspiration.
limitations.zh: HydroVerse沉浸式课堂受制于较高的技术和后勤要求、用户获得适用硬件及可靠互联网的差异、支持不同学习者及技术熟练程度的挑战，以及数字化身缺乏同理心、激励和启发等人类特质。

papers.title: HydroScholar AI: A Collaborative Agent for End-to-End Automated Hydrological Research Lifecycle

summary.en: HydroScholar AI turns an approved hydrological plan into executable code, figures, and a draft manuscript while recording prompts, approvals, edits, executions, and file changes.
summary.zh: HydroScholar AI 将经批准的水文计划转化为可执行代码、图表和论文草稿，同时记录提示、审批、编辑、执行和文件变更。

details.en: The human-in-the-loop platform integrates planning, Python generation, execution, debugging, visualization, and drafting in one auditable workspace. Its hydrology-aware prompt library covers direct access to sources such as USGS NWIS and NOAA data, hydrological conventions, and standard analyses. The demonstration analyzes five years of daily streamflow for the Iowa River at Iowa City, including annual mean flow, seven-day low flow, and peak-flow dates, and produces a baseline manuscript in a single recorded session. The provenance log preserves the human–AI decision path so generated results can be inspected and reproduced.
details.zh: 该人在回路平台将规划、Python 生成、执行、调试、可视化和撰写整合在一个可审计的工作区中。其水文学感知提示库涵盖对 USGS NWIS 和 NOAA 数据等来源的直接访问、水文惯例和标准分析。该演示分析了 Iowa River at Iowa City 五年的每日流量数据，包括年平均流量、七日低流量和峰值流量日期，并在一次完整记录的会话中生成基线论文草稿。溯源日志保留了人类–AI 决策路径，因此可以检查和复现生成的结果。
